Kafa ya ɗaga yana kokarin haurinta, hakan da ta gani ya sanyata saurin janye cikinta tana mirginawa can gefe guda. Lokaci guda tsoro na kara baibaye mata zuciya jikinta ya ɗau rawa.

"Farouq lafiya kake?".

Ta faɗi cikin nishin wahala sabida yadda take jin ɗan cikinta yana tokare mata mara.

Takowa ya yi yana kusanto ta, hakan ya sanyata koƙarin ja da baya amma lokar dake wajan ta tokare. Da sauri ta shiga koƙarin miƙewa, amma kafin tayi wani hanzari ya iso gareta ya cafki wuyan rigarta yana miƙar da ita tsaye har kafafuwanta na rabuwa da kasa, hakan ya sanya idanunta fitowa sosai waje suna kaɗawa jajir, kiciniyar ƙwace kanta tayi amma riƙon da ya yi mata bana wasa bane.

"Farouq...Ka sake ni don Allah".

Ta faɗi da ƙyar tana kaiwa fuskarsa duka, amma hakan bai sanya shi sakinta ba.

"Na faɗa miki, ba sau ɗaya ba, ba dau biyu ba, amma kin kasa fahimta to daga yau zan nuna miki iyaƙar ki".

Ya faɗi yana mai sauke ta kasa gami da kokarin kwantar da ita, amma mutsu-mutsun da take ya kasa samun damar yin abinda yake so, kafarsa ya ɗaga yana koƙarin take mata ciki hakan ya yi mugun firgita ta bata san lokacin da ta kwalla kara tana kiran sunansa ba, taka cikinta da ya yi hakan ya yi daidai da juyawar ɗan cikinta ya yi, wani irin nishi ta saki kafin ta shiga koƙari kamo wuyan rigar Farouq amma ta kasa hannunta ta janye da sauri tana mai laluban lokar dake wajan kanta a hankali har ta isar da hannunta saman loka ɗin fitilar dake saman lokar  taji hannunta ya riko, aiko tana dageta ta sauke masa a tsakiyar kai, wani ihu ya kurma lokaci guda ya na mai faɗuwa ta baya.
Ihun da Farouq ya yi ba karamin razana ta shiga ba, duk da yanayin da take jin kanta a ciki na kasala da ga cikinta da yake ta faman juyi kamar zai fito, amma hakan bai hanata jin wani tsoro ya ziyarci zuciyarta ba, rutse idanu tayi tana buɗewa.

Faruwar komai gani take kamar a mafarki ba gaske ba, a hankali ta waiga daga kwancen da take tana duban hannunta mai riƙe da fitilar da ta kwaɗawa Farouq zuciyarta taji tayi tsalle tana komawa mazauninta da sauri ta saki fitilar ta shiga yunkurin tashi, amma riƙon da bayanta ya yi hakan ya sanyata komawa tana lafewa.

Idanunta ta lumshe na yan dakiƙu kafin ta buɗe su lokaci guda. Wani karfi take ji ya zo mata daga zuciya, laɓɓanta ta tura cikin baki tana cizawa kafin ta yunkura ta miƙe zaune, ko ina na jikinta lokaci guda taji ya ɗau rawa hannunta ta  sanya tana janye ƙafar Farouq dake jikinta yashe  tana mai dafa gefen gadon ta sanya guiwowinta a kasa don bata ji za ta iya miƙewa, fuskar Farouq take duba yanayinsa ya tabbatar mata ko motsi ba ya yi hannunsa ɗaya na dafe da goshinsa inda ta rotsa masa fitilar.

Ware idanu tayi sosai tana dubansa ƙafarsa dake gefe da ita ta kama tana jijjigawa amma ba alamun motsi tana saki ta faɗi yaraf! Hakan ya kara rura wutan tsoron da take ciki. Rarrafawa tayi tana faman cizon baki ta isa saitin fuskarsa hannunta ta kai tana dafa kirjinsa, shiru taji da sauri takai saitin wuyansa ko za ta ji harbawar jijiyarsa nan ma shiru.

"Farouq".

Ta faɗi da karfi cikin yanayi na tsoro, idanunta lokaci guda suka kawo kwalla. Sake kai hannu tayi tana janye hannunsa daga goshinsa, lokaci guda ta runtse idanu kafin ta buɗe  goshin take kallo yadda ya kumbura ya yi suntum! wajan ya yi jajir fatar wajan ta dauke jini ya tsantsafo amma ba sosai ba.

"Don Allah ka tashi Farouq".

Ta faɗi jikinta na sake ɗaukar rawa, zuciyarta take ji tana koƙarin kekkecewa lokaci guda kwakwalwarta taji tayi shiru kamar babu komai a ciki, Ihun Farouq ne kawai take ji yana amsa mata kuwwa ta ko ina.

Runtse idanu tayi da karfi. Ta kasa yarda wai Farouq ne a wannan yanayin, ta kasa yarda ita ce sila, zuciyarta ba za ta iya daukar kalar tashin hankalin nan ba, komai take ji yana takurewa gareta.

Cigaba tayi da girgiza kai har zuwa wannan lokacin idanuwanta a runtse suke bata son cigaba da kallon yanayin da yake ciki bata so ta kalli goshin sa ta hango makeken ciwon dake wajan bata so ta ji wai ita ce sanadinsa ba za ta iya ɗauka ba komai take ji yana canza salo tashin hankalin ta na sake nunnunkuwa.

Za ta iya rantsewa bata taba tsintar kanta cikin wani yanayi mai kama da tashin alkiyama ba irin yau. Ta kasa yarda. Kokarin buɗe idanu take yi amma zuciyarta yadda take jin tana bugawa da wani irin ciwo mai girma da yake taso tun daga kasanta ba ta jin in ta buɗe idanun zata kalli Farouq ba tare da zuciyar ta ta tarwatse ba.

Hannunta ta kai tana dafa kirjinsa a hankali, kamar wacce take kokarin taɓa wuta, dannawa tayi amma ko kadan ba ta ji alamar motsi ko bugawar zuciya ba, hakan ya kara bata damar dannawa da karfi duk da sanyin da jikinta ya yi amma tana jin wani karfi da jarumta daga cikin zuciyarta yana samun wajan zama a dukkanin sassan jikinta.

"Bana son kalar ukubar nan Farouq, bana son ka hukuntani ta wannan yanayin. Don Allah ka tashi, ka buɗe idanunka ka kalle ni ka yi ma ni duk wani kalar hukunci zan amsa amma ban da wannan kalar".

Ta faɗi tana mai cigaba da danne masa kirji da dukkan hannayenta biyu, amma ba abin da ya sauya don ji take kamar tana danne dutse.

Buɗe idanunta tayi tana mai sake dubansa kafin ta ɗauke kai ta shiga kokarin miƙewa amma hakan ya gagara sanadin zama da tayi kan ƙafarta ta dama wani irin riƙewa ta ji tayi ga bayanta da yake tsungulinta amma duk hakan bai dameta ba kamar yadda take cike da tashin hankali da yanayin Farouq.

Daƙyar ta samu ta miƙe amma bayan ya riƙe haka take a ɗan duƙe.Toilet ta nufa cikin wannan yanayin ruwa ta ɗebo kusan rabin karamin bokiti ta nufo cikin ɗakin dashi, kallo ɗaya tayi masa ta ji zuciyarta na kara matsewa a mazaunita da wani irin tashin hankali.

'Don Allah kar ka mutu Farouq, ban shirya karbar tashin hankalin nan ba, kar ka min haka'

Zancen da take ta faman yi kenan tsakanin kwakwalwarta da zuciyarta kafin ta shiga zuba masa ruwan a hankali amma ba alamun ya san ana zuba masa ruwan.

Sakin Bokitin tayi ya dire a kasa tana mai daura hannunta saman kai kamar mai shirin kurma ihu amma sai ta fasa. Ta nufi kofar fita daga ɗakin da sauri tana faman nishin wahala.

'Idan kika fita ina za ki je?. Kina nufin zuwa za ki yi ki faɗawa Nasreem kin kashe shi?.

Turus! ta ja ta tsaya jin zancen da wani sashi na zuciyarta ke tambayarta, wani jiri ta ji yana koƙarin yasar da ita, da sauri ta dafa bango tana mai dafe goshinta da hannu ɗaya.

"Innalillahi wa inna ilahir raji'un".

Abinda take ta faman furtawa kenan cikin rawar murya, komai take ji ya tsaya mata cak! Duniyar take ji gabaɗaya tsaya mata cak! kamar wata daban aka jefata a ciki ba wacce take tun fil'azal ba.

"Yaaa Rabbi...Ka dubi zuciyata ka dubeni da Rahamarka ba da niyya nayi ba, nayi dom cetar da Gudun jinina...Yaa Ilahi kar ka ɗaura min Ƙaddarar da ba zan iya ɗauka ba Yaa Ilahi ka dube ni...".

Wani kuka ne mai ciwo a dukkan sassan jiki da zuciya ya kwace mata, zafinsa take ji yana gajiyar da duk wata gaɓa ta jikinta, kuka ne wanda ba hawaye sai zafin idanu da take ji fuskarta take ji tana ɗaukar ɗumi, kanta kuwa ji take kamar zai tarwatse ta ko ina.

Kuka take yi mai tafe da nishi, da koƙarin kassara duk wata jijiya da mugadan jini dake gangar jikinta, kafafuwanta taji suna ƙokarin yasar da ita bata san lokacin da ta zame zuwa kasa tayi zaman yan bori ba, ta shiga nishi tana mai dafe kirjinta da take ji kamar a buɗe an kwarara mata ruwan dalma tafasasshe.

"Mijin Nasreem".

Muryart Nasreem ta tsinkayo kamar tana nufo sashinta, wata irin dokawa zuciyarta tayi, cikon hanzari ta buɗe idanunta tana mai duban inda take jiyo sautin muryar, kafin lokaci guda ta miƙe zumbur kamar bata ɗauke da wani kayan nauyi a gangar jikinta.

A hankali ta shiga ja da baya, zuciyarta na sake kecewa da karkarwa, ɗakin ta nufa amma idanunta na sashin da take tsinkayo muryar Nasreem.

Da karfi ta tura ƙofar ta shiga tana mai da kofar ta rufe, gami da zamewa ta zauna idanunta kur! inda Farouq yake yashe har zuwa wannan lokaci ba alamun motsi a tattare dashi.

"Yaa Rahamu...Yaa Rahimu...".

Ta faɗi tana mai yunkurawa ta miƙe daƙyar, a lokacin ɗan cikin nata ya sake juyawa da wani irin yanayi mai nuna da yana cikin koshin lafiya, da sauri ta dafe cikin nata don ji tayi kamar zai faso fatar cikinta ya yo waje.

Da jan ƙafa ta isa inda yake durkusawa tayi gabansa, zuciyarta take ji tana dannewa da wani irin ciwo mai girma wanda ta kasa tantace na menene kallon fuskar Farouq take kiyayyarsa da wani sashi take yi takeji tana koƙarin danne mata dayan sashin mai shakƙa akan sa, runtse idanu tayi tana buɗewa, hannayenta duk biyu ta kai saitin bakinsa tana buɗewa, kafin ta kai nata tana haɗewa da nashi, wani irin abu taji ya tsirga mata tun daga tafin kafarta har zuwa tsakiyar kanta amma hakan bai hanata yin abinda tayi niyya ba, numfashi tashiga tura masa ta hanyar nishi, idanuwanta a lumshe hawaye sai zubo wa suke kamar an buɗe famfo mara guda. Ta kai minti biyu a haka kafin ta ɗauke kanta tana zama sosai tana mai da numfashi.

"Farouq".

Ta faɗi da sanyin muryar cikin yanke tsammani.

"Don Allah ka tashi".

Ta sake faɗi muryarta na karyewa da wani irin yanayi, wanda ke sanya idanunta sake kecewa da zubda hawaye.

"Mijin Nasreem".

Nusaiba za ta iya rantsewa taji lokacin da ɗan cikinta ya fito sannan ya koma sabida tsananin tsabar tsoro da razana da tayi jin muryar Nasreem tana turo kofar ɗakinta.

"Me kika yi masa, kin kashe shi ko?".

Kalaman Nasreem ta sake jin sun sauka cikin kanta da wani irin yanayi. Runtse idanu tayi ta buɗe su tana mai sauke su a saitin Nasreem ɗin wacce ta kara so cikin ɗakin ta doshi inda Farouq yake a yashe.

"Me kika yi masa?".

Nasreem ta faɗi cikin daga murya da yanayin tsoro a fuskarta, hannayenta jikin Farouq tana jinjingasa. Nusaiba dai gyaɗa kai kawai take tana bin ta da kallo, don ita kam a wannan yanayin ba ta jin ko KALMA ƊAYA zata iya faɗi a tsakanin laɓɓanta da take jin sun mata wani irin nauyi na ban mamaki.

Ihu Nasreem ta saki tana mai ɗaura hannu aka, tana mai rusa kuka kafin ta sauke tana girgiza Farouq wanda har zuwa wannan lokaci ba alamun zai yi motsi, miƙewa tayi cikin rawar jiki tana duban Nusaiba dake zaune kamar wata butum butumi ta nufe ta gadan-gadan ta cakume ta.

"Ki faɗa min abinda kika yi wa miji, ki faɗa min ba kashe shi kika yi ba?".

Ta faɗi tana mai jinjigata amma Nusaiba kwankwarar motsi takasa domin ita kadai ta san yanayin da take jin ta a ciki.

"Na rantse da girman Allah in har Farouq ya mutu ke ma sai na kashe ki".

Ta faɗi tana mai sakar mata wuyan riga, gami da hanƙaɗa ta baya, kafin ta fice daga ɗakin da gudu tana faman rusa ihu.

"Allahummma Ja'anni fi musifabatin...".

Nusaiba ta shiga faɗi, wani kuka na kwace mata tun kafin ta karasa, hannayenta ta sanya tana dafe kirjinta zafi take ji yana yi mata wanda take jinsa har fuskarta, idanunta sun ƙafe ba alamun hawaye sai nishin kukan ne kawai ke fita.

"Zo ka gani ta kashe shi, wallahi ta kashe min miji".

Muryar Nasreem ta sake ji ta karaɗe ɗakinta, dubanta tayi kafin ta sauke idanunta ga maigadin da ta shigo dashi, wanda kallo ɗaya tayi masa ta hango razana a idanunsa, ɗauke kanta tayi tana kallon lokacin da ya nufi inda Farouq yake yana mai taɓa kirjinsa zuwa wuyansa.

"Ka taimaka mu kai shi asibiti...".

Ta faɗi cikin rawar jiki tana mai kama hannunsa guda tana riƙewa cikin nata, Maigadi ya shiga kiciniyar ɗaukarsa, yana faman nishi don Farouq yana da nauyi duk da rashin kibarsa. Haka maigadi ya sagala shi a kafaɗarsa Nasreem ta taimaka masa suka fice dashi daga cikin ɗakin.

Fitarsu ya yi daidai da faɗawar wani abu da ya tsaya wa Nusaiba a wuya, lumshe idanu tayi tana buɗe su a hankali, kwakwalwarta take jinta fayau kamar takarda, komai jin sa take yi kamar mafarki ba gaske ba, amma yadda zuciyarta ta kasa zama waje ɗaya hakan ya tabbatar mata da komai ya rigaya ya faru.
***
Cizon laɓɓanta take ta faman yi, don ita kaɗai ta san azabar da take ji a daidai wannan lokaci.Kallon Nasreem take wacce take zaune bakin gadon da Farouq yake kwance an daura masa drip kansa kuma anyi masa Dressing ɗinsa an nannaɗe shi. Ina ma za ta samu daman kuka har da hawaye kalar na Nasreem ta tabbata da ta samu  sauki cikin zuciyarta sai dai hakan ya gagara, HAWAYEN ZUCI kawai take wanda take jin su suna zagaya duk wata kusurwa ta zuciyarta suna ƙonata.

"Nusaiba ki samu waje ki zauna mana".

Hajja ta faɗi dake zaune kan kujera kusa da Farouq ɗin. Girgiza kai Nusaiba tayi don bata jin zata iya zama bayanta a riƙe yake shiyasa tun da ta shigo ɗakin take a tsaye ta kasa ko motsawa sai faman nishi take. Kafafuwanta ta kalla wanda suka kumbura sukayi suntum wani irin tausayin kanta na sake danne ta.

"Tsayuwar nan ba za ta yi miki ba Nusaiba, ki dubi yadda kafafuwanki suka kumbure".

Hajja ta sake faɗi tana mai duban kafafuwan Nusaiba ba yabo ba fallasa.Amma duk da hakan Nusaiba najin wani iri a zuciyarta game da Hajja yau kwana biyu kenan da kwanciyar Farouq asibiti, tunda Nasreem tace Nusaiba ce ta so kashe shi, shikenan Hajja ta tsume mata fuska shiyasa ta janye cikinta ta koma gefe, ba za ta ce ta ga laifin Hajja ba tunda duk wanda ya ga halin da Farouq ke ciki dole yace kashe shi ta so yi, shiyasa bata ga laifin Hajja ba don ta nuna damuwa da rashin jin dadinta, Ɗan ta ne gudan jininta dole ta ji ciwo a zuciyarta, kamar yadda itama ta shiga tashin hankali har ta nemi ceton jaririn dake cikinta.

"Dama kin daina ɓata bakin ki,Mugun halinta sai dai ya kare akanta".

Nasreem ta faɗi tana mai gallawa Nusaiba harara kamar idanunta za su faɗo kasa, kafin ta juyawa wajan Farouq wanda yake ta faman barcin wahala tun da ya farka ya koma barci, sabida ciwon kan dake takura masa sosai.

Nusaiba sai da ta ji tana kokarin faɗuwa sannan ta ɗan ja ƙafa bayan ta cewa Hajja zata koma gida bata jin daɗin jikinta, gyaɗa mata kai kawai tayi ba tare da ta ce da ita kala ba. Hakan ya yi mata dadi ita kam don gabaɗaya a muzance take a ɗakin musamman kalar kallon da Nasreem ke mata lokaci-lokaci kuma suna hira da Hajja amma ba sa saka ta ciki.
***
Kallonsa Mami take yi tana faman gyaɗa, don ta rasa abinda za ta ce. In tace bata yi kewar Jamaal  ba to tayi wa kanta karya, kawai dai ba yadda za tayi ne, tun lokacin da ta fahimci cewa akwai dalilinsa na ƙin dawowa gida, gabaɗaya hankalin ta ya kasu biyu rabi na ga Nusaiba rabi na gare shi.

"Jamaal".

Ta sake faɗi tana mai kure shi da idanu, wani irin girma na ban mamaki taga ya yi mata duk da ya yi rama ya kuma yi baƙi amma hakan bai boye yanayin girma da ya kara ba. Sajen da ya tara ƙewaye da fuskarsa da bata san shi dashi ba, amma yanzu gashi nan ya kara fiddo da kwarjininsa da girma sosai.

"Ban san me zan ce da kai ba Jamaal, amma har ga Allah shirun nan da kayi mana ya taɓa ni tsayin shekara ba kwanaki, ba kai ba alamar ka, wayar ka sai a shafe wata ba ajika ba, ko da an same ka kullum cikin uzuri kake ai aiki ne ya hana ka dawowa....Allah na gani ni dai kawai jin ka nake".

Cigaba ya yi da juya Coffee ɗinsa idanuwansa a kasa wani irin yanayi yake jin kansa a ciki, tun da ya baro wajan aiki da zubar zuwa gida yake jin kansa duk a takure, kawai ba yadda zai yi zuciyarsa ta karkato gida amma bai yi niyyar waiwayen gida a wannan lokacin ba.

"Mami mana, ban taɓa yi miki haka ba , sai wannan karon".

"Ni ban ce na damu ba, kawai mamaki nake ta yadda bikin Nusaiba ya tashi amma ka kawo uzuri shima ban taba zaton haka ba".

Wani abu ne dunkule yaji ya taso tun daga kasan zuciyarsa ya zo tsakanin makoshinsa ya takore, numfashi ma daƙyar yake yi wani gumi na rashin dalili yaji yana tsantsafo masa.

"Ka shirya zuwa anjima, zamu gidan Nusaiba dama bata jin dadi".

Dago kai ya yi yana duban Mami kamar zai ce wani abu, sai kuma ya fasa yana miƙewa saman kafafuwansa.

"Bari naje na ɗan runtsa zuwa jimawan".

Gyaɗa masa kai tayi tana binsa da kallo wani irin yanayi take jin zuciyarta na shiga game da Jamaal ɗin, tausayinsa take ji yana danne mata ko ina na jikinta, daga kasar zuciyarta ta ji wani abu mai girma da ta jima  ajje dashi yana taso mata, wanda ta tabbatar a yanzu ba wani tasiri da zai yi a gareta har dashi Jamaal ɗin.
***
Riƙe take da kofi mai ɗauke da haɗaɗɗen shayin da ta haɗa, wanda yaji kayan kamshi irin su, citta, kanumfari, tafarnuwa, da kuma Tea Spices na Fee'ah. Wanda Mami ne ta haɗo mata shi tace ta dinga amfani dashi lokaci zuwa lokaci, sai dai tunda ta fara amfani dashi ya zame mata kamar jiki kullum sai ta sha shi.

Kurba tayi don ba za ta iya bari sai ta kai ɗakinta ba, wani irin tsinkewa take jin miyan ta ya yi har kayancinta take ji suna yamutsewa.
Sauke kofin tayi tana kokarin hawa matattakalar ta ga mutum a gabanta, wata irin dokawa ta ji zuciyarta tayi, kofin da ke hannunta bata san lokacin da ta sake shi ya watse a kasa ba, runtse idanu tayi tana buɗewa. Mamakin ganinsa take a gabanta, don rabonta dashi tun ranar da ya farka ya ganta a asibiti ya mata korar kare gami da ci mata mutunci a bainar nasi mutanan asibiti da majinyata suna ta kallonsu abun ya tsaya mata a rai don sai da ta kwana ta hantse tana faman kuka.

Numfashe ta ajje tana mai kokarin ja da baya amma kafafuwanta ta ji sun riƙe sosai, hakan ya sanyata runtse idanu tana buɗewa, da karfin tsiya take son daga kafar amma hakan ya gagara.

Wani Murmushi ya saki, kafin ya kai hannunsa yana dafa goshinsa.

"Kin yi zaton za ki yi nasara a kai?".

Ya faɗi yana mai nufota hakan ya sanya ta kokarin ja da baya amma ta kasa, har ya iso gareta yana mai shaƙo wuyan rigarta hannu ya ɗaga ya kifata mata mari gami da kara nannaɗe wuyan rigarta a tsakanin hannayensa yana haɗa kanta da jikin karfen benen.

Wata irin kara ta ji ta dire mata cikin kai, kafin lokaci guda ta ji komai ya tsaya mata cak, ji tayi kamar tana yawo akan gajimare kafin lokaci guda ta ji ta watse a kasa bayanta na wata irin ansawa  hakan ya sanyata sakin wani irin azababben nishi, lokaci guda ta ji mararta ta murɗe kamar kayan cikinta za su zubo gabaɗaya,

"Yaa Ilahi".

Ta furta daƙyar idanunta kafe a na  Farouq da take ganinsa dishi-dishi jinin dake zubowa a goshinta yana wanke mata fuska.

"Na tsane ki Nusaiba, na tsani rayuwa dake bana bukatar cigaba da ganin fuskarki a gidana...ki tashi ki tafi na sake ki...na sake ki Nusaiba Saki biyu".

Runtse idanu tayi kalaman Farouq take jinsu kamar sukar kibiya a zuciya, gabaɗaya  ta ji duniyar ta murɗe mata gami da haɗewa waje guda tana matsewa, tana kallonsa ya taka ta gefenta yana wucewa har yana harbin kafafuwanta wanda taji kamar lema ta wanke mata su.

"Na sake ki biyu Nusaiba....".

Ya sake faɗi cikin daga murya, kamar wanda ya samu taɓin hankali, kofar fita daga falon ya nufa a daidai lokacin kuma aka turo kofar idanun sa na sauka cikin na Mami a bayanta kuma Jamaal ne biye da ita. Kallon kallo aka shiga yi a tsakani kafin ya matsa gefe.

"Ina so kafin naje na dawo, kin tattara ƴarki kin fice min da ita daga gidan na, na sake ta bana bukatar ganin idanunta a gidana".

Ba Mami kaɗai ba hatta Jamaal sai da ya yi mutuwar tsaye a wajan, a lokacin kuma Nusaiba ta kira sunan Mami da karfi jin wata irin azaɓa da ta danne mata baya zuwa mararta.
Saukar sautin muryar Nusaiba cikin kunnuwanta, ta ji wani abu yana tsinkewa a cikinta, bata san lokacin da ta juya tana sake kallon Farouq, wanda shi kansa yaji ihun kiran da Nusaiba tayi  hakan ya sanya kwakwalwarsa wata irin ɗaukar kara zuciyarsa na matsewa a tsakanin kirjinsa.

Kokarin ɗaga kafafuwansa yake ya bar wajan, amma hakan ya gagara wani irin sanyi yake jin jikinsa ya ɗauka, idanuwansa ya runtse yana mai buɗe su. Mami ta zo ta wuce shi da wani irin yanayi mai tattare da mugun tsoro haɗi da firgici tana nufar cikin falon.

Fuskar Jamaal yake kallo wanda ke tsaye gabansa, idanunsa kafe a saitinsa gabaɗaya ya kasa motsi bugun zuciyarsa yake ji tana sauyawa da wani irin yanayi wanda ya jima bai ji hakan ba, numfashi yaja yana mai runtse idanu kirjinsa yake  ji ya ɗauki wani kalar ɗumi kafin ya tura laɓɓansa yana cizawa a hankali yana sake buɗe idanunsa da suka kaɗa sukayi jajir  yana ajje su a saitin Farouq ɗin.

"Jamaal".

Ya ji muryar Mami ta kira shi cike da matukar tsoro a cikin muryar ta ta, girgiza kai ya shiga yi wani abu yake ji a zuciyarsa wanda ya kasa tantace na menene, kafin ya yunkura ya nufo cikin falon da wani irin karfi da kwarjini da suka cikawa Farouq idanu.

Shigar falon ya hangi Mami tallabe da Nusaiba wacce gabaɗaya ta fice daga hayyacinta sai faman murkususu take fuskarta wanke da jini  haka kafafuwanta jini da wani abu kamar ruwa ke binta yana malala saman tayal ɗin wajan.

Zuciyarsa ya ji tayi tsalle da karfi har sai da ya kai hannunsa yana dafe kirjinsa kafin yaji ta koma mazauninta, zan iya rantsewa bai taɓa ganin tashin hankali tsurarsa irin yadda ya ga Nusaiba da Mami a ciki ba, duk da artabu da suke shiga daji sunayi da yan ta'adda suna ganin yadda suke kashe mutune yana jin wani iri a zuciyarsa amma kalar tashin hankalin da yake hange tsakanin Mami da Nusaiba ya danne masa dukkanin jikinsa da zuciya kafafuwansa yaji suna kokarin kada shi.

"Jamaal ya kashe min Nusaiba...ya kashe min ita".

Mami ta faɗi muryarta cike da kuka tana mai sake rungume Nusaiba a jikinta gabaɗaya jikinta itama ya baci da jini.

"Ba zan yafewa Farouq ba Jamaal, ba zan taɓa yafe masa ba...".

Ta faɗi tana mai koƙarin cicciciɓar Nusaiba amma nauyin ya fi karfin ta hakan ta koma tayi kasa amma ba ta saki Nusaiba ɗin ba da take ta faman nishi idanunta na kwararar da ruwan hawaye goshinta na cigaba da zubda jini.

"Ki yafe min Mami".

Nusaiba ta faɗi a tsakanin laɓɓanta da wani irin azababben yanayi wanda ita kadai ta san yadda take ji, komai najikinta take ji kamar ana saka allurai a wuta ana sassoka mata.

A razane Mami ta dubi Nusaiba jin muryarta can kasa, sake riƙota tayi sosai kamar za su shige jikin juna.

"Nusaiba ki tashi don Allah kar ki mutu,ba zan iya ɗaukar kalar ƙaddarar rasa ki ba, na san ban kyauta miki ba, kiyi hakuri kar ki mutu ki sake bani dama...".

Juyawa tayi tana duban Jamaal dake tsaye kamar butum-butum zuciyarsa ce kawai ke bugawa amma ba yadda ke motsi a jikinsa.

"Kar ka bari ta mutu Jamaal. Kayi mata magana kar ta mutu ta bar ni ba zan iya ba, zuciyata za ta fashe...Jamaal ka taimaka mu kaita asibiti...".

Yanayin firgicin Mami jin sa yake yi yana sake narkar masa da duk wani kuzari nasa, wata irin ajiyar zuciya ya yi, yana jan kafafuwansa da sukayi masa nauyi sosai ya nufi inda suke. Fuskar Nusaiba yake kallo zai iya rantsewa yaji lokacin da zuciyarsa ta rabe biyu tana komawa ta haɗe, yanayin Nusaiba gani yake kamar ba ita ba gani yake kamar wata ce daban aka canza masa, ya kasa yarda ita ce hannayensa yake kokarin kai wa ya riƙo ya taimaƙa mata amma hakan ya garara sabida shakka da yake yi akan cewa Nusaiba ce a gabansa, Nusaiba ce ta sauya haka, ita ce ta koma kamar wacce ta shekara cikin kwanciyar jinya.

Anya ya yi wa kansa adalci, anya bai yaudari kansa ba, anya bai ɗauki haƙƙi ba?. Yar uwansa tana cikin wannan yanayin amma ya kasa zuwa ya taimaka mata ya TALLAFI rayuwarta bayan kuma yana da damar haka. Me yasa yaje ya zauna, me ya shiga kansa har ya kasa dawowa gida har hakan ta kasance?.

Dole ya yi wa kansa hukunci, domin ya cancanci fiye da duk wani hukunci da yake jin ya kamata ya yankewa kansa.

Da wannan tunanin ya sake yunkurin taimakawa Mami ganin sai kiciniya take kafaɗun Nusaiba ya kama gami da miƙar da ita zaune, Mami na kama kugunta suka miƙar da ita sai dai ta kasa tsayuwa, sai a lokacin Jamaal ya lura da katon cikin da ke jikinta zuciyarsa yaji ta ɗauki rawa duban Mami ya yi wacce fuskarta tayi kace-kace da hawaye da majina.

"Sake ta Mami".

Ya faɗi yana mai sukuntar ta gabaɗaya yana haɗewa da jikinsa ko kadan bai damu da yanayin da take ciki ba, da yadda jini da ruwan dake fitowa daga jikinta suke ɓata masa farin yadin dake zaune jikinsa, kofar fita ya nufa gadan-gadan zuciyarsa na sake rikice masa.

Motarsa da suka zo da ita ya buɗe gidan baya ya sakata, a lokacin Mami ta iso gyale a hannu takalma duk a hannu.

"Ina tunanin har da haihuwa Jamaal, ban san yadda za ayi ba don bana tunanin akwai kayan haihuwa a tare da ita, kawai mu wuce asibitin".

Ta faɗi tana mai dubansa kafin ta shiga gidan bayan tana rungume Nusaiba wacce har zuwa wannan lokaci tana faman nishi gumi sai karyo mata yake ta ko ina. Gidan gaba Jamaal ya shiga yanayi wa motar key ya nufi Gate cikin hanzari kamar zai tashi sama, mai gadi na ganin haka ya yi a zaman buɗewa yana komawa gefe, don duk abinda ke faruwa akan idanunsa.
***
Kai kawo kawai Mami take tsakanin kofar dakin da filin wajan, yanayinta kawai zaka kalla ka san a mugun firgice take idanuwanta sun kaɗa sun yi jajir gumi sai faman karyo mata yake, laɓɓanta kawai ke motsawa ta faman addu'ar da duk ta zo bakinta.

Ta fara karaya da lamarin Nusaiba abu ɗaya kusan awa bakwai amma ba labari, haihuwa taki yi har yanzu, bata san ya za ta yi ba in ta rasa Nusaiba, zuciyarta ba za ta iya ɗauka ba.

Nufar ɗakin tayi a karo na ba'adadin tana mai riƙe handle ɗin kofar amma gam take a rufe, likita da Nurse har sun gaji da cewa ta fita don da ta ji ya ya sai ta faɗa ganin tana neman raba musu hankali biyu hakan ya sanya su kulle ɗakin ba yadda ta iya haka ta hakura, tun tana kukan da hawaye har idanunta suka kafe ta koma na zuci.
Komawa tayi tana kokarin zama, kamar wacce ta zauna saman allura haka ta miƙe jin an taɓa kofar an fito. Likita ne dan haka da sauri ta nufe shi, kallon da take masa na tuhuma ne, amma ko kadan bai kula da hakan ba illa zare gilashinsa da ya yi yana goge gumin da ya wanke masa fuska, kafin ya saki wata ajiyar zuciya mai karfi.

"Hajiya kiyi hakuri....".

Ai bata san lokacin da ta katse shi ba, jin yadda jiri yake kokarin kwasarta, bata shirya amsar kalmar hakuri a irin wannan yanayin ba, zuciyarta za ta fashe in har akace tayi hakuri in ta rasa Nusaiba ba za ta iya ɗauka ba.

"Don Allah kayi shiru".

Ta faɗi da karfi tana mai ɗaga masa hannu, kafin ta dora da faɗin.

"Kar ka ce min ta mutu, karka ce min na rasa ta, wallahi likita ba zan iya ba, ba zan iya ɗaukar wannan tashin hankalin ba, ka taimake ni".

Ta karashe da wani irin yanayi hannunta dafe da kirjinta da take ji yana ta faman dokawa. Kallonta ya yi yana mai girgiza kai a idanunta yake hango zallar kauna wanda yake da tabbacin kauna ce ta tsakanin uwa da ƴa ya lura da hakan a tsakanin Mami da Nusaiba.

"Kiyi Hakuri ba mutuwa tayi ba, haihuwar ne dai har yanzu, yanayin karfin jikinta ya yi kadan da za ta iya haihuwa da kanta ga bugun zuciyarta da yake sauyawa a duk daƙiƙa komai kuma zai iya faruwa...a shawarce me zai hana ayi mata Cs in har ba damuwa a gareku don hanya ɗaya kenan da nake da tabbacin za ku samu rayuka duka biyun, amma in har aka ce za a jingirta har ta haihu da kanta to za a iya rasa  ɗaya cikin biyu ko  rasa uwar ko kuma rasa ɗan koma ku rasa su baki ɗaya...".

Wani gwauron numfashi Mami ta ajje mai tafe da hawaye kafin ta sanya hannu tana ɗauke su ta shiga gyaɗa kai.

"Likita ayi duk abinda ya kamata in har zan samu ɗiyata, ban damu don ɗan cikinta ya mutu ba, ka faɗa min yadda za ayi yanzu don Allah likita kar a ja lokaci".

Gyaɗa kai ya yi.

"Ina mijin nata don shi ne wanda zai sanya hannu a takarɗa aiki na tabbacin ya yarda".

Sai a lokacin Mami ta tuna da wani Farouq a rayuwarta, wata irin bugawa zuciyarta tayi mai cike da takaici da dana sanin yarda Nusaiba ta auri Farouq, sai yanzu take jin zuciyarta na kara tsanarsa laɓɓanta ta ciza kafin ta dubi likitan.

"Likita ni uwa ce gareta, nima zan iya yi. Don Allah kar kace sai mun nemo mijin nata".

"Amma yana dakyau ko ba mijinta ba, a samu wani shaƙiƙi nata da zai sanya hannu".

"Likita mana. Na faɗa maka ga abinda ya kamata ayi, jira ba namu bane, sannan in ma shaƙiƙi ne tare da Ɗan'uwanta muke ya fita ya dawo ko shi zai sanya hannu, amma bana so ace sai mun jira wani yazo. ka yarda kawai na saka hannu ai nima Uwa ce kuma mai girman kusanci a wajanta".

"Shikenan".

Ya faɗi yana mai duban Nurse ɗin dake bayanta alamu ya yi mata da hannu kafin ya wuce ita kuma ta dubi Mami.

"Muje ko Hajiya".

Ba tare da ta ce da ita komai ba, ta bi bayanta har suka isa wani Office inda ake cike File da biyan kuɗi. Nan Mami ta biya aka bata File don ta cike zama tayi riƙe da biro a hannunta amma ta kasa yin rubutu ko kalma ɗaya wani irin bugawa take jin zuciyarta nayi tsoro na mamaye ta.

Wai ita ce yau zata saka hannu don ayi wa ƴarta aiki, a ciro ɗa daga cikin cikinta.Girgiza kai take yi wani tsoro take ji yana mamaye dukkanin jikinta, bata san abinda zai faru ba in ta saka hannu, bata san ya Nusaiba zata kasance ba, Shin in ta mutu shikenan?.

Da sauri ta runtse idanu tana mai gargaɗin zuciyarta da kalar wannan tunanin da take kawo mata, numfashi ta ja ta fesar tana mai daura biron sama File ɗin amma ta kasa yanayin jikinta ba karamin sanyi ya yi ba. Kamar daga sama ta ji an riƙo hannunta gami da danna bakin biron kan File ɗin ana rubuta abinda ya kamata, kiciniyar ƙwace wa take amma ta kasa, hannun ta shiga bi da kallo kafin ta daga kai tana duban fuskarsa.

"Jamaal".

Ta faɗi hawaye na wanke mata fuska, girgiza kai ta shiga yi alamun rashin yarda, tsoro na bayyana a fuskarta sosai. Wani kwantaccen murmushi bayya ne a fuskar Jamaal yana mai riƙo hannun Mami ya miƙar da ita so yake yi ko ya ya ne ya bata wani kwarin guiwa don abinda ta fi bukata kenan a yanzu, duk da shi kansa dauriya kawai yake amma ba zai iya kasancewa su zama ɗaya ba, ya kamata ace ya bata hope da zai sanyata cikin natsuwa da tabbacin za ta samu Nusaiba.

"Ki daina kuka Mami, addu'a don Allah....Addu'arki take bukata ba kuka ba, don Allah ki daina kukan nan".

Ya faɗi yana mai ɗauke File ɗin yana miƙawa Nurse dake tsaye wacce ita ma fuskarta duk tayi kalar tausayi, hannu ya kai yana gogewa Mami hawaye a hankali yana kara karfafa mata guiwa akan tabbacin da Yardar Allah Nusaiba zata tashi har da ɗan dake cikinta.

Cikin mintina goma anyi komai an gama sai kokarin shiga Theater Room ake da Nusaiba, a lokacin Mami da Jamaal suka dawo daga sallar Isha'i da suka je yi.

Kan idanunsu akan gunguro da Nusaiba kan gadon sanye da riga goriya kanta sanya da hula kalar rigar goshin ta nannaɗe da bandeji. daga gefen gadon dan karfe dogo wanda aka rataye Drip da aka sanya mata, idanuwanta a buɗe suke tana faman kallon sama.

"Nusaiba".

Mami ta faɗi tana mai nufo wajan gadon da sauri ganin Nurse din na koƙarin shigar da ita Theater Room ɗin. Hawaye ke koƙarin zubo mata, Jamaal ya yi saurin girgiza mata kai idanunsa cikin nata, ba yadda ta iya haka ta daure tana mai ɗaurawa fuskarta murmushin yake.

"Nusaibata. Da Yardar Allah za ki samu lafiya, kar ki ji komai a ranki, ki saka a ranki gaki ga Maminki da Abbanki har da Yaa Jamaal ɗinki...za mu cigaba da yi miki addu'a ni da Yaa Jamaal Abbanki zai ke miki daga can in da yake kisan kuma addu'ar Iyaye girma gareta ga Ƴaƴansu Ina son ki ƴata".

Mami ta karashe muryarta a karye kuka na kokarin kwace mata da sauri tayi kasa da kai hannnunta riƙe da na Nusaiba da take faman bin su da kallo fuskarta tayi fayau kalar tausayi.

Idanunta ta ajje a saitin Jamaal, kallonsa take yi wanda shi kansa har sai da yaji zuciyarsa ta motsa da yanayin tsoro, murmushi ya yi mata yana langaɓar da kai itama murmushin ne ya bayyana akan fuskarta kafin ta lumshe idanu. Nurse ɗin na tura gadon  zuwa cikin ɗakin suna mai da ƙofa suka rufe bayan likitoci biyu sun shiga.

Wani kuka ne mai ciwo a zuciya ya kwacewa Mami gefe ta koma tana haɗa kanta da bango, ta kasa yarda wai ƴarta ce cikin wannan yanayi, zuciyarta ta ƙi aminta wai Nusaiba ɗinta ƴarta ce aka shigar dakin Theater za a farka cikinta domin ciro ƊA.

Wani irin tsoro ta ji ya danne mata zuciya, duniyar take ji tana sauya mata ta tsoratar da ita, tabbas ta yarda duk wani mai numfashi a duniyar nan, ba zai taba cewa rayuwarsa daidai take ba har sai ranar da numfashinsa ya ɗauke, bawa ba shi da ikon gadara da kansa game da halittarsa har sai lokacin da ya mutu tabbas ta yarda bawa ba a bakin komai yake ba, komai kuma a rayuwar bawa da zai faru dashi MUƘADDARI NE wanda ya ke tafiya da zanen ALKALAMIN ƘADDARA ba wa bai taɓa wuce kaddararsa kamar yadda a yanzu ƙaddarar Nusaiba ya kasance ta hanyar ciro mata ɗa ba tare da ta haihu da kanta ba.

Dago kanta tayi tana faman ajiyar zuciya, kuka ba na ta bane, bashi ne abinda Nusaiba take bukata a wannan yanayi ba, Addu'ar take bukata a matsayinta na uwa ita ce kawai za ta yi mata a matsayin gata da kauna. Duban Jamaal tayi ya haɗe hannayensa da fuskarsa ya jingina da bayan kujerar da yake zaune a kai.

"Jamaal"

Ta faɗi cike da sanyin murya. Cire hannayensa ya yi yana dubanta da idanunsa da suka ƙada, gyaɗa mata kai ya yi yana miƙewa.

"Addu'ar Mami zo muje muyi mata addu'a don Allah".

Ya faɗi yana mai riƙo hannunta suka ficewa daga sashin ɗakin Theater ɗin.
Masallacin dake cikin asibitin GENERAL HOSPITAL na cikin Minna suka nufa, Alwala Jamaal ya yi bayan ya tabbatar Mami tayi ta koma gefe kadan ta shinfiɗa sallayar da ya ciro ma ta cikin mota sallar nafila ta shiga jerowa kafin s ya shiga masallacin yana dorawa domin gatan da za suyi wa Nusaiba kenan a daidai wannan lokaci su kai kukansu wajan Allah shine mai Rahama Mai jiƙan bawansa,mai tausayinsa da biya masa bukatu ba tare da ko sisin bawa ba.

***

Wani farinciki ne ya mamaye zuciyarta, gabaɗaya ta kasa zaune ta kasa tsaye, sai faman kai koma take yi cikin ɗakin bakinta kamar ya yage, lokaci lokaci take tashi tana taka rawa kamar wacce akayiwa albishir da gidan aljanna.

Wayarta ta janyo tana mai lalubo lambar  Batool ta danna mata kira tana ji ta daga ko sallama babu ta shiga kora mata bayani.

"Batool ba san wani irin kalar farinciki zan faɗa miki nake cika ba, amma ji nake kamar an saka ni cikin aljanna".

Murmushi Batool tayi sautinsa na fitowa har ta cikin wayar kafin ta ce,

"Bani labari me ke faruwa?".

Wani irin ihun murna Nasreem ta saki tana mai tashi tsaye tana faɗawa tsakiyar gadon, ta shiga murginawa.

"Farouq ya saki Nusaiba saki ɗaiɗai har biyu, Farouq ya zama Mallakina ni kaɗai...Batool da gaske nake faɗa miki".

Ba za ta iya tantace yanayin da take jin kanta aciki ba, amma tabbas ta ji wani abu mai kama da noti ya kwance ya faɗa cikin kwakwalwarta.

"Gani nan zuwa tun jiya na dawo, yanzu haka shirin zuwa gidanki nake".

Batool ta faɗi da yanayi ba yabo ba fallasa, hakan ya sanya Nasreem sake sakin ihu tana miƙewa tsaye.

"Kar ki min kalar wasan nan Batool ki faɗa min gaskiya".

"Gaskiyar kenan ki zuba idanu a hanya nan da 30mint".

Tana kokarin sake magana taji an turo ƙofar an shigo. Farouq ta gani yanayinsa kawai ta kalla ta ji ziciyarta ta doka har wayar dake hannunta ta kusan suɓucewa, sauke wayar tayi tana mai dubansa sosai, yanayinsa na kara sanya zuciyarta bugawa.

A hankali yake shigowa cikin ɗakin yana faman haɗe hanya, hannunsa guda saman goshinsa da yake ji kamar zai rabe gida biyu, shi kadai ya san yanayin da yake jin kansa a ciki duniyar yake ji tayi masa shiru kamar ba kowa sai shi kadai.

Gefen gadon ya zauna yana ma sakin ajiyar zuciya mai karfi, kafin ya dago kansa ya dubi Nasreem da take tsaye kamar wata butum-butumi, kau da kansa ya yi yana mai faɗawa gadon ta baya idanunsa a buɗe suna kallon saman ɗakin.

"Farouq!".

Ta faɗi da wani irin yanayi, wani tsoro na danne mata zuciya lokaci guda, za ta iya rantsewa bata taɓa ganin Farouq cikin wannan yanayin ba.

"Ki bar ni...ki bar ni don Allah bana so".

Ya faɗi yana mai janyo filo yana danne kansa dashi. Buɗe idanunta tayi sosai tana dubansa muryarsa yadda ya yi mata magana da sauti mai girma a cikinta bai taɓa  yi mata ihu ba tunda ta samu ya shigo hannunta.
***
Hawaye kawai ke cigaba da wanke mata fuska, suna gangarawa zuwa filon da ta ɗaura kanta a kai, wani irin ciwo take ji yana taso mata daga karkashin zuciya yana wargajewa a dukkanin sassan jikinta, ji take kamar ta haɗiyi zuciya ta mutu ko ta huta da raɗaɗin da ciwon rai da take jin kanta a ciki.

Runtse idanu tayi tana sakin numfashi, ka fin ta buɗe tana karewa ɗakin asibitin kallo, a ranta take ji ina ma mutuwa tayi ina ma ace tun a ɗakin theater ɗin bata farfaɗo ba ina ma ace numfashinta ya katse tun kafin kwanakin nan biyu da yi mata aiki, komai take ji ya wargaje mata, komai take ji na gangar jikinta kamar ba nata ba, wata irin muguwar tsana take jin zuciyarta na kara share fage akan Farouq.

Bata taɓa zaton da gaske Farouq ya tsane ta ba, bata taɓa zaton abin da yake aikawata gaskiya ne ba, sai a wannan karon ta yarda zuciyarta ta tsane shi ta yarda duk wani burbushin son da take masa ya bar zuciyarta kamar yadda ɗan dake cikinta ya bar cikinta haka take jin zuciyarta na kankare duk wata kauna da so da take yiwa Farouq.

Ta yarda bata da nasara a rayuwa, tunda har ta kasance a kalar yanayin nan, ta yarda so bai yi mata adalci ba, tunda har Farouq ya tsane ta tsanar da take jinta tana raba mata zuciya zuwa gida biyu.Za ta so ace ta bar  duniyar nan don bata ga amfanin rayuwarta a ciki ba, tunda har zuciyarta ta tsani Farouq bata jin akwai ranar da zata samu farinciki a rayuwarta.

Za ta so ace ta mutu za ta so ace ta bar duniyar nan don bata ga amfanin rayuwa a cikinta ba, bata hango wani farinciki a cikinta ba, ko da ta cigaba da numfashi tabbas cikin kankanin lokaci ciwon dake cikin zuciyarta zai zama ajalinta.

Hannunta guda mai drip take bi da kallo yadda ya kumbura cikin kwanaki biyu bata san adadin drip da aka ɗaura mata ba amma ta tabbata ba kadan bane.Numfashi ta ja a karo na ba adadi hawayen da suka cika mata idanu suna zubowa.

"Ban san sai yaushe zaki daina kukan nan ba Nusaiba, ban ga amfanin ɓata lokaci da kike yi akan wani dalili da kika tabbatar da ya rigaya ya faruwa, wanda ya kamata ace kin dauke shi a matsayin ƙaddara amma kin kasa hakan. Ban san me kike so kuma ki jefa kan ki a ciki ba".

Mami dake can gefe zaune rungume da jaririn da Nusaiba ta haifa tana shayar dashi madara kamar yadda likita ya bukata, tunda Nusaiba kwananta biyu da yin aiki amma bata farka ba, ta farka a daren da akayi mata aiki amma yanayin da take ciki ya sanya likita ɗaura mata wani drip mai ɗauke da sinadarin allurar barci, sabida matsala da ya hango in har aka barta ta farka komai zai iya faru da ita.

Idanunta take yawatawa da su a saitin jaririn wanda yake kunshe cikin lallausar tawul yana ta faman mutsu-mutsu da tanɗan baki, wani abu taji mai kama da dutse ya tokare mata zuciya runtse idanu tayi da karfi tana jin ko ina na jikinta na ɗaukar dumi hannu biyu ta sanya tana dafe kanta da take jin yana barazanar rabewa biyu.

"Meye haka kike yi Nusaiba, Drip ne fa a hannunki, ki ajje hannun da kyau mana, kina kallon yadda hannunki ya kumbure sanadin motsa shi da kike yi, bana son sakarci".

Mami ta faɗi tana mai miƙewa saman kafafuwanta ta nufeta hannunta ɗaya rike da jaririn ɗayan hannun ta saka tana saukewa Nusaiba hannun da ta ɗaura a kai idanunta runtse amma hawaye sai faman zuba suke.

"Mami don Allah ki bar ni kaina ciwo yake, ni ban ga amfanin rayuwa ta a duniyar nan ba, ban ga amfanin numfashi na ba, Me yasa ban mutu ba Me yasa?".

Ta karashe tana rushewa da kuka mai sauti, hannunta ta kai kirji tana dafewa ji take yi kamar ana zuba mata narkarkiyar dalma a ciki kasusuwan hakarkarinta take ji suna amsawa kamar za su tarwatse.

"Me yasa ban mutu ba?".

Ta sake faɗi tana mai durza hannayenta duk biyun a saman kirjinta kafin ta shiga juye-juye tana nishin kuka wanda take jin azaba ta ko ina idanunta take ji suna ɗaukar zugi da raɗaɗi.

"Nusaiba".

Mami ta faɗi da karfi cikin yanayi na tsorata, kafin ta juya da sauri tana ajje jaririn cikin gadonsa ta nufa inda take hannunta mai ɗaure da drip ɗin ta fara rikewa sannan ta zauna gefen gadon tana kokarin ganin ta daina mutsu-mutsun da take yi.

"Nusaiba me ye haka kike, kina cikin hayyacinki kuwa?".

"Mami ki bar ni na mutu, ko na cigaba da rayuwa a nan gaba, zuciyata dole zata tarwatse, bana kaunar cigaba da numfashi mutuwa nake so Mami".

Ta karashe cikin yanayi na wahala kafin ko ina na jikinta ya fara gajiya da motsin da take dama ba wani karfin jiki ta samu ba. Hakan ya sanya Mami gyara mata zaman hannun mai drip kafin ta miƙar mata da kafafuwanta da ta haɗe su da cikinta.

"Nusaiba Me yasa kika kasa yin tawakkali?. Ke fa musulma ce kuma kisan rashin dacewa ga musulmi ya furtawa kansa son mutuwa, kamar yana jayayye ne da yanayin ƙaddara da jarabawa da Allah ya rubuto masa a rayuwa take dawainiya dashi. Me yasa ba za ki ɗauki wannan al'amarin a matsayin MUƘADDARI ba, me yasa ba za ki ɗauki komai na rayuwa a matsayin jarabawa daga Allah ba, komai fa ya samu bawa daga Allah ne, ba wai daga wani bawa ba. Kar ki yarda ki saka a ranki cewa abinda ya faru dake wani bawa ne ya sanya ki, a,a ki saka. ranki komai ya faru dake Ƙaddara ce rubutacciya daga Allah tun fil'azal Allah ya halicce ki da wannan rayuwa sai ta same ki, me yasa ba za ki yi tawakalli ba ki rungumi komai ki fawwallawa Allah lamuranki shi zai kawo miki sauƙin komai da komai".

Girgiza kai kawai take tana faman cizon laɓɓa, kafin ta buɗe idanunta tana saukewa a saitin Mami wani kuka taji ya zo mata amma ta danne shi tana mai ɗauke kanta daga kallon Mami wani irin abu take ji yana sake danne mata zuciya bata san ya zata kwatantashi ba, za dai ta iya kiranshi da 'Azababben ciwo' wanda take ji kamar ita kadai ce a filin duniyar nan ta taɓa jinsa kuma ta tsinci kanta a wannan matakin.

'Na sake ki saki biyu'.

Wani sashi na kalaman Farouq taji suna yi mata ihu cikin kai da wani irin yanayi mai kama da ana kwaɗa mata guduma cikinsa, nishi kawai take don kukan ma ya tsaya mata cak! lokaci guda zafin zuciyane dana kirji kawai ke nukurkusarta.

"Ki daina wannan kukan Nusaiba, zuciya bata min dadi".

Mami ta faɗi tana mai kai hannunta goshin Nusaiba tana shafawa.

"Bana so na rasa ki Nusaiba, ke kaɗai ce ɗiya mace da nake da ita a filin duniyar nan, in na rasa ki ban san wani hali zan shiga ba, ki tausaya min ki tausayawa kan ki, ki tausaya wannan bawan Allah ɗanki...ko don saboda shi Nusaiba ki cire wannan kuncin na zuciyarki, ba kan ki farau ba, don haka ki miƙawa Allah lamarinki shi zai kawo miki sauki".

Jin Mami kawai take amma bata jin rayuwa zata sake waiwayo ta har tayi farinciki a cikinta shiyasa ta so ace ta mutu hakan shine kawai take hangowa a matsayin mafita a gareta, ba wai zaman duniyar nan ba da ta tabbata komai zai ta tafiya ne a cikin kunci har zuwa lokacin da zuciyarta zata kumbura tayi bindiga.

Miƙewa Mami tayi ta nufi inda gadon jaririn yake, ɗauko shi tayi ta nufo inda Nusaiba take gefenta ta kwantar dashi tana mai faɗin.

"Ki dube shi ko don shi Nusaiba, ko dan shi da bai san komai ba, yanzu rayuwarsa zata soma, kar ki yi kokarin mai da ɗanki maraya...Don Allah".

Yanayin da ta ji muryar Mami kamar zata yi kuka hakan ya sanyata saurin juyowa tana duban Mami ɗin kafin ta ɗauke kanta wani irin nauyi na sake danne mata zuciya.

'Na tsane ka Farouq, bana kaunar sake ganin ko fuskarka'.

Wani sashi na zuciyarta ya shiga karanto mata kalaman na amsa kuwwa cikin kunnuwanta, lumshe idanu tayi tana buɗewa lokaci guda kafin ta dubi gefen daman ta Jaririn take kallo da wani irin yanayi, kallonsa take ta ji zuciyarta na buɗe wani gurbi gami da share shi wani abu game da jaririn take ji yana samun wajen zama sosai cikin gurbin yana mamaye ilahirin zuciyarta kafin ta ji ya gangara jikinta da jijiyoyinta suna ɗauka, suna haifar mata da wata irin kasala wacce ta kasa gane ta menene.

Mami ta kalla wacce itama kallonta take idanunta sun kaɗa kaɗan, kafin ta sakar mata murmushi don bata so Nusaiba ta hango rauninta bata so Nusaiba ta hango irin ciwon da ita kanta take ji a zuciyarta, ba ita kadai zuciyarta ke suya ba har da ita wani irin yanayi take jin kanta aciki kamar tana da hannu wajan jefa ƴarta cikin wannan uƙubar rayuwar ba abinda ya kara ɗaga mata hankali sai ta yadda Mami ta faɗawa Hajja haihuwar Nusaiba da halin da take ciki amma yau kwana biyu ko sawunta wani daga dangin Farouq bata gani ba, hakan ba karamin kara kona mata rai yayi ba har ta ji a ranta dole ta ɗauki mataki dole ta nuna musu ƴarta ba baiwa bace sannan ba bora bace. Ba wai ba sa sonta bane suka ɗauke ta suka basu, a,a sai don aure da ƙaddara ta zano sai ta zauna cikin dangin su.

Numfashi taja mai zafi tana fesarwa wani ɓacin rai na sake danne mata zuciya, tana cigaba da duban Nusaiba ta gyaɗa mata kai fuskarta da murmushin yaƙe don ta karfafa mata guiwa.

"Ko in dora miki shi ne".

Mami ta faɗi tana kara faɗaɗa murmushinta ganin yadda jikin Nusaiba ya yi sanyi kalau wajan shagala da kallon yaron, ta na hango wata rikitacciyar kauna gami da zallar son jaririn a idanun Nusaiba wacce ta tabbata mai girma ce kauna ce wacce ta kasance daga Allah kauna ce wacce take tabbatuwa tsakanin Uwa da Ɗa, ita kanta ta san kalar kaunar nan don gata nan tana jinta a zuciyarta game da Nusaiba.

Kau da kai Nusaiba tayi murmushi take so tayi amma ta kasa zuciyarta sai hasko mata fuskar Farouq take ta jin wai shine suka haɗu suka saman da wannan ɗan tare mutumin da ya kasance mara imani da tausayi wai shi za ta duba a matsayin wanda za ta kira da sunan Uba ga ɗan nan nata.

"Yaa Ilahi...".

Ta furta daƙyar a tsakanin laɓɓanta da take jin sun mata nauyi sosai.

"Kunya Nusaiba, Kar ki ce min kunya ta kike ji".

Mami ta faɗi murmushin dake kwance a fuskarta sautin sa na fita har zuwa kunnuwan Nusaiba wanda hakan itama bata san lokacin da murmushi ya kunce mata ba mai tafe da hawaye.

"Ki nuna masa kauna Nusaiba, ki kauna ce shi da dukkan zuciyarki, kar ki bari wani abu da ya faru tsakaninki da Farouq ya sanya ki masa ƙyuwar soyayyarki a matsayinki ta UWA gareshi, kar ki bari hakan ya yi tasiri ki kauna ce shi da dukkan zuciyarki ɗanki ne daga jikinki ya fito".

Nishi tayi wanda take jin zafinsa kamar an hura mata wuta a kirjin, runtse idanu take yi fuskar Farouq na sake bayyanuwar mata so take yi ta manta dashi, so take yi ta yage shi daga dukkan tunaninta amma hakan ya garara. Don bata ji zata iya mance fuskarsa, bata jin zata iya mance wanene shi, zuciyarta ta bashi gurbi mai girma wanda a yanzu take ji ya cure ya zama gurbin da ta danne da kiyayyar da take ji tana yi masa.

Juyowa tayi tana sake duban ɗan nata wanda take jin zuciyarta da dukkanin jikinta suna bashi gurbin zama lumshe idanu tayi tana buɗe su tana jin zuciyarta na sauye bugu game dashi. Wai ɗanta ne da gaske ita ta haife shi a cikinta?.

Kai ta shiga girgizawa kafin ta daga hannunta mai drip tana mai shafar kwantacciyar sumar dake kansa wani irin abu take ji kamar shock na bin jikinta lokaci guda wanda hakan ya sanyata ɗan yunkurawa kamar zata tashi tana komawa ta kwanta.

Kofar ɗakin aka turo aka shigo. Jamaal ne hannunsa ɗauke da ledoji da wani madaidaicin basket ɗauke da kuloli, tunda ya sanya kai cikin ɗakin Nusaiba ke bin shi da kallo wani iri take kallonsa yanayin da ta ganshi a ciki duk ya canza mata ya rame sosai ga gashin sajen da ya fara tarawa duk ya yi wani iri alamun ba gyara, wanda ta alakanta haka da yanayin da take ciki ne ya jefa shi wannan yanayin na rashin gyaran don bata san Yaa Jamaal da kalar halin nan ba, na rashin tsafta.

"Mami".

Ya kira yana mai ajje kayan da ya shigo da su gefe guda, a jikinsa yake jin kallon da Nusaiba take masa amma ya ƙi kallonta don har yanzu zuciyarsa a nauyi take gani yake kamar dukkan abin da ya faru da ita har da saka hannunsa in da yana nan da duk haka ba za ta faru ba.

"Har ta farka kenan?".

Ya faɗi yana mai duban Mami, gyaɗa masa kai tayi tana duban Nusaiba ɗin wacce har lokacin idanunta na buɗe a kansa.

"Kin kira likita Mami?. Ya kamata ace an kira shi da ta farka, kar wani abu ya faru kuma".

Yanayin da ya yi maganar ya sanya Mami dubansa, yaƙe ya yi mata kafin ya kai idanunsa saitin Nusaiba yana dubanta yana duban hannunta dake saman kan jaririn tana shafawa a hankali.

Ganin tana koƙarin ɗago kanta, hakan ya sanya shi saurin janye idanunsa yana mai nufan hanyar fita daga ɗakin.

"Mami bari na kira likita, bai kamata ace ta farka an barta haka ba, hannunta ya kumbura kar ya yi mata ciwo".

Ya karashe yana mai ficewa daga cikin ɗakin da sassarfa, gami da jan ƙofar.
***
Yatsine fuska take faman yi kamar wacce take shan maɗaci, tana faman turo baki gaba. Mami ke riƙe da kofi tana baiwa Nusaiba Tea ɗin fuskarta a ɗaure alamun tsare gida.
"Ni ban taɓa ganin mai taurin kai irinki ba Nusaiba, ace abinci sai na matsa miki za ki ci, maimakon ace a wannan yanayin kina cin abinci hannu baka hannu kwarya, amma ke ko kadan kamar wacce bata da hanji".

"Allah Mami bana jin yunwa ɗazu fa ki ka gama matsa min naci tuwo...".

Harara da mami ta galla mata ya sanyata tsuke bakinta gami da turo shi gaba.
"Oh ni Hawwa".

Mami ta faɗi tana mai ɗorawa da.

"Jego fa kike Nusaiba ko dan yaron nan ai kya ciki ko ya samu ruwan Nono, amma ke gabaɗaya ba damuwarki bane kin fi so ku zauna ki ta figewa ga  tsotso ga wannan ciwon na cikinki da bai  warke ba, in ba kya cin abinci kina tunanin duk waɗanan abubuwan zaki samu warakar su".

Ita fa bata ga wani abu da yake burgeta a yanzu ba, abincin ma jin sa take kamar ana mata ɗuren magani, shiyasa sam bata son ci don wani zubin in Mami da takura mata ji take kamar zata amayo da kayan cikinta har sai in Mami ta nuna mata ɓacin rai take dannewa.

"Amma Mami...".

Turo ƙofar da akayi ne ya sanyata tsuke bakinta, tana mai saita idanunta a ƙofar Yaa Jamaal ne ya shigo hannunsa rungume da jaririn yana faman jinjiga shi, bata san ina ya koyi ɗaukar yara ba, ita dai gidan su babu yara bare ta ce Mami na haihuwa nan ya koya, ko ita bata iya riƙe shi kamar yadda yake riƙe shi, tana mamakin yadda yake iya ɗaukar awanni dashi a hannu ba tare da ya gajiya ba, a matsayinsa na Namiji maza da aka ce basu iya ɗaukar yara kanana ba, ko sun ɗauka nan da nan za su dawo  da su su ajje suna faman korafi ya yi musu tumbuɗi ko ya yi musu fitsari, amma Yaa Jamaal ko kadan ba shi da kalar haka ko fitsarin ya yi masa ita da Mami ba sa sani sai dai su ga ya sanya masa ruwa ya cire wandon in ba a saka masa pampers ba ya saka masa da kansa.

"Kun yi baƙi Mami".

Yanayin da ya yi furucin ya sanya Mami dubansa fuskarsa take kallo yanayinsa akwai damuwa ko ma tace ɓacin rai hakan ya tabbatar mata da cewa baya mara ba da baƙin da yace tayi.

Miƙewa tayi tsaye tana miƙawa Nusaiba kofin Shayin dake hannunta.

"Ki shanye shi kafin su shigo kin ga har ya fara hucewa, in kuma ba haka  ba ga Jamaal nan ya sanya ki dole wallahi".

Tura baki tayi kamar ba za ta amsa ba, jin Mami ta ambaci Yaa Jamaal hakan ya sanyata ansa da sauri tana dubansa ta gefen idanu amma sai ta ga hankalinsa baya ma kan su idanunsa na zube a fuskar yaron.

"Su waye?".

Yatsi ne fuska Ya yi.

"Za su shigo yanzu".

Kallon shi Mami tayi sosai, kafin ta ɗauke kai a ranta take ji tabbas zarginta ya tabbata ko su waye ɓaƙin Jamaal baya maraba da su. Gyaɗa kai kawai tayi tana mai duban Nusaiba.

"Ki Hanzarta shanyewa mana sannan ki lullube jikinki".

Sai lokacin ya ɗaga kai ya dube ta, yanayin da ya ganta a ciki ya sanya shi kau da kai. Riga ce mai hannun vest a jikinta kasancewar ɗinkin dake cikinta shiyasa bata sanya kaya masu nauyi.

Karasawa ya yi inda gadon yaron yake kamar zai kwantar dashi sai kuma ya fasa ya ja kujera ya zauna, yana mai cigaba da ya shafa masa kai a hankali.

Mami dake tsumayen ya bata ɗan ya shigo dasu ganin ya zauna hakan ya sanya nufar ƙofar, tana koƙarin buɗewa ana kokarin turowa hakan ya sanyata sakin kofar tana dawo da baya idanunta kan kofar har aka turo.

Da Murmushin yaƙe a fuskarta ta shigo tana saukewa a saitin Mami wacce take tsaye ta harɗe hannu ganin wacce ta shigo ɗin mamaki ne ya cikata, bata taɓa kawowa ranta za ta ga ƙafar Hajja ko wani dangin Farouq  ba don tuntuni ta  yanke tsammani ganinsu yau haihuwa kwana shidda ba dangin miji ba shi kansa mijin.

Gyaɗa kai tayi tana maidawa Hajja murmushin yaƙen da take ta faman zabgawa wacce da ka kalle ta za ka gane na borin kunya ne kawai.

"Bismillah".

Mami ta faɗi bayan ta amsa mata sallamar da tayi, tana bata hanya domin wuce wa ciki.

"Sannunku Jidda Barkanmu".

Kallo kawai Mami ke bin ta dashi tana gyaɗa kai, wani haushi na danne mata zuciya, amma ta shiga hakurkurtar da kanta don bata so ta nuna ɓacin ranta akan lamarin DANGIN FAROUQ.
**
"Barkanmu".

Mami ta faɗi bayan ta samu kanta daƙyar wajan danne ɓacin ran dake nukurkusarta, kafin ta nufi bakin gadon da Nusaiba take wacce ta sunkuyar da kai kasa hawaye na ta faman zubo mata, sam bata so ace wata alaƙa ta shiga tsakaninta da Farouq ko fuskarsa bata son gani kamar yadda bata son ganin wani daga cikin danginsa da hakan zai tuna mata shi.

Mami na lura da ita hakan ya kara ɓata mata rai sosai ta shiga duban Hajja wacce take ta faman yaƙe tana duban yaron dake hannun Jamaal tana kuma duban Nusaiba so take yi ta ce wani abu amma yadda ta ga duk sun tsume mata jikinta ya yi sanyi sosai kawai daure take.

"Wallahi jidda lokacin da kika sanar dani haihuwar nan, bana gari shiyasa kika ji ni ɗif ban samu damar zuwa ba".

Hajja ta faɗi daƙyar tana mai kokarin yalwata murmushinta, don ita kanta ta san bata kyauta ba, ba yadda za ta yi ne kawai, ba yadda ba tayi da Farouq ba,don sai da tayi masa tatas! lokacin da Mami ta kira ta faɗa mata haihuwar amma da ta kira Farouq sai ya nuna mata  shi bai san da haihuwar ba daga karshe ma ce mata ya yi ai Nusaiba ɗin bata gidan bai ma san inda tayi ba.

"Ayya ai bakomai".

Mami ta faɗi tana mai duban Jamaal, hankalinsa gabaɗaya baya kansu kamar ma bai san Allah ya yi ruwansu a wajan ba.

"Jamaal".

Mami ta kira. Dago kai ya yi ya kalleta fuskarsa a haɗe kamar hadari, tun da yaji ta kira shi ya san abinda take nufi. Don haka yana ganin ta masa alama da idanu ya ɗauke kansa.

"Bata shi mana".

Ta sake faɗi don bata so Hajja ta gano yanayinsu gabaɗaya kuma bata so ace sun nuna mata ɓacin ransu, so take cikin ruwan sanyi ta dafasu su dahu luguf don ta lura abin har da rainin hankali a cikinsa.

Ace mace ta haihuwa, ta hanyar aiki amma a rasa wanda zai zo ya duba ta shi kansa Farouq ɗin ai ya kamata ace ya zo duk da yanayin da suke ciki akwai haƙƙi akansa na kula da yaro da ita lafiyar Nusaiba ɗin ko da kuwa ya sake ta amma da yake dan zamani ne tsakaninsa da uwar tashi da  ta faɗa mata babu wanda ya zo kuma ta san ta faɗi cewa kawai bata nan ne don kare kai. Daga yanayin ta tun shigowarta ta gane haka.

Miƙewa ya yi ransa ɓace ya nufi inda Mami take ya miƙa mata ɗan kallon idanunsa tayi ya ɗauke kansa ba tare da tace dashi komai ba, ta amshi yaron tana miƙewa ta nufi inda Hajja take zaune, ansar sa tayi.

"Kai Masha Allah gashi nan sak! kamar Farouq ya yi ka ƙi, kai yaron nan akwai ɗan banza yanzu ace da rabo irin wannan amma kai ta ɗaukar haƙƙin matarka ban san abinda ya hau kansa ba".

Hajja ta shiga faɗi tana mai kallon fuskar yaron. Mami dai kawai kallo take bin ta dashi kafin ta ɗauke kai tana duban Nusaiba wacce izuwa wannan lokaci ta daina kukan amma kanta a kasa sai faman ajiyar zuciya take.

"Sannu Nusaiba Rabbi ya karo afuwa ya karo karfin jiki Sannunki da kokari".

Ta sake faɗi tana duban Nusaiba wacce jinta kawai take don gabaɗaya in ranta ya yi duba to a kuntace yake, ji take yi kamar ta ɗaura hannu aka ta kurma ihu ko ta samu sassaucin ciwon da take jin zuciyarta na sake ɗauka. Ba abinda ya kara ƙona mata rai sai yadda Hajja take faɗin yaron ta ya yi kama da Farouq ita kam ko kaɗan bata ga wata kama ba. 

Ɗan ta bai yi kama dashi ba kuma bata fata ace ya yi kama da shi ɗin, don hakan ba karamar barazana bace a gareta,ace ɗan da ta haifa ya yi kama da mutumin da ta tsana tsanar da take jinta har saman harshenta tana yi mata ɗaci-ɗaci, so take ta manta dashi so take ta manta da wani mai kalar sunan Farouq duk da ta san hakan ba mai yuwuwa bane amma dole ta yaƙi ce duk wani abu da zai kawo mata tunaninsa cikin zuciyarta har ya hana ta sukuni.

"In ka fita kace wa Farouq ya shigo".

Hajja ta faɗi tana duban Yaa Jamaal dake kokarin fita daga cikin ɗakin, cak! ya tsaya jin abinda ta ce juyowa ya yi gabaɗaya fuskarsa da wani irin yanayi, kafin ya dubi Mami da ta zabga tagumi idanunta a saitin Hajja, kallonsa tayi ita ma tana mai masa alama da idanu, girgiza mata kai ya shiga yi yana koƙarin magana tayi saurin tare shi.

"Jamaal mana".

Shiru ya yi yana tura laɓɓansa cikin bakinsa yana cizawa da karfi, kafin ya yi wa Hajja wani kallo yana mai ficewa daga cikin ɗakin.

Nusaiba jin abinda Hajja tace wata irin ranaza tayi, don sai da taji wani abu ya tsirga mata cikin ciki kamar ɗinki da aka mata ya kwance lokaci guda idanunta suka sake kaɗawa sukayi jajir ta shiga nishi, numfashinta take ji yana kakkatsewa yana kokarin ɗaukewa hakan ya sanyata buɗe baki gami da kai hannunta tana dafe kirjinta.

Komai ta ji ya sake jagule mata, ganin Farouq a gabanta a yanzu daidai yake da fashewar zuciyarta, bata jin zata iya wannan kasadar, bata jin zata iya jure ganinsa ko da na sakan ɗaya ne.

"Mami".

Nusaiba ta faɗi da wani irin yanayi wanda ya sanya Mami saurin dubanta yanayin da ta ganta ciki ya kaɗa mata ciki da sauri ta miƙe tana ɗauko flast mai ruwan dumi ta zuba a kofi ta miƙo mata a tunaninta ko shakkuwa ce ta danne ta ganin ta riƙe kirjinta amma sai taga ta ɗauke kai idanunta na kawo hawaye.

"Me ke faruwa ne haka, ko jikin ne?".

Hajja ta faɗi ganin yanayin da Nusaiba take ciki. Ba wanda ya tanka mata Mami ta koma ta zauna idanunta a cikin na Nusaiba ta shiga gyaɗa mata kai ta na mata alama da idanu amma ko kaɗan Nusaiba bata jin akwai wani abu da zai yi tasiri a yanayin da take jin kanta a ciki a yanzu, da hanzari ta ziro kafafuwanta tana kokarin sauka daga gadon ta ji gefen cikinta inda ɗinkin yake yana ɗaukar wani yanayi da ya sanyata sakin nishi gami da rankwafawa kaɗan.

Sai da ta ɗauki sakanni a haka Hajja sai faman tambaya take ko lafiya?. Amma ba wanda ya kulata takaici ne ya danne Mami shiyasa ko kala bata ce mata ba don ta tabbata zuwan su ne musamman da ta ji da Farouq ya jefa Nusaiba cikin wannan halin, inda da yadda za ta yi wallahi da ta hana Farouq shigowa amma hakan kamar ta nuna cewa akwai matsala tsakaninsu ita kuma bata so a ga rashin hakurinta tun yanzu ta fiso sai komai ya lafa duk wacce za ayi sai ayi.

Toilet ɗin ɗakin ta nufa da sauri tana faman gumi kamar wacce ta haɗiyi kunama, tana shiga ta danno kofa da karfi tana mai zama jikinta jikin kofar da wani irin yanayi wanda take jin ko ina na jikinta na ɗaukar ciwo musamman zuciyarta da gefen cikinta inda akayi mata ɗinki. Numfashi take ja a hankali tana maidawa idanuwanta tarwai cikin toilet ɗin, ji take kamar ace ta ɓace ta bar ma asibitin baki ɗaya amma ta san hakan ba mai yuwuwa bane, hannayenta ta sanya tana toshe kunnanta bata so ko muryarsa ta ji don ta tabbata in Jamaal ya faɗi masa zai shigo ɗin.

Daga can cikin ɗakin kuma Hajja ce ta dubi Mami, da tayi shiru hannunta guda tallafe da kumatunta.

"Yarinyar nan daga gani ta sha baƙar wuya, haihuwa irin wannan akwai ciwo ga ɗinki kafin ma ya warke wani jidali ne,Yanzu Jidda ya ake ciki tunda Nusaiba dai hannunmu take cikin zuri'ata take dole hakkokinta akanmu suke".

Gyaɗa kai Mami take tana dubanta ta gefen idanu wani haushi yana danneta, jin wai ai a zuri'arta Nusaiba take kenan tana nufin sakin ma da akayi bata sani ba ko ya ya?. Gaskiya mutanan nan akwai rainin wayo sai yanzu ta kara fahimtar gabaɗaya ba su ɗaukar mata ƴa a mai daraja da ƙima ba shiyasa Farouq ya share fage ya dinga keta mata rashin mutunci son ranta har ya kai ga kusan kashe ta.

"Wai nikam Hajja shi Farouq ɗin bai faɗa miki abinda ke faruwa bane a tsakaninsa da Nusaiba?".

Mami ta faɗi don gabaɗaya ta gama gajiya da rainin hankalin Hajja ɗin gani take kamar da gangar take zantukan nan nata in ba rainin wayo ba ta ya ya za ayi saƙi amma ta zo irin tashin hankalin ta nuna na Farouq bai kyauta ba sam bata nuna ba sai faman kwaso wasu zantuka take wanda suke kara kular da ita tana faɗi, ita ba damuwarta bane don ba su yiwa Nusaiba komai ba, ba damuwarta bane don ba su zo sun duba ta ba tunda ƴarta na hannunta Allah ya rabo ta da UƘUBAR da take ciki.

Cikin rashin fahimta Hajja ke duban Mami, yanayin ta kawai ya tabbatar mata da akwai matsala. Cikin rawar baki da nuna tashin hankali, don ta san yanayin zaman nasu hakan ya kaɗa mata ciki, kar dai ace wani abu Farouq ya yi wa Nusaiba gaban danginta, in kuwa haka ya kwance mata zane a kasuwa ta shiga uku.

"Wallahi bai faɗa min komai ba, don Allah kar ki ce min matsala suka samu, kar ki ce min wani abu ya sake yi mata".

Kallo kur! Mami take mata tana nazarin zancenta wato ma ta san Farouq na cutar da Nusaiba kenan amma sukayi ƙe-madagas!. Tsabar son zuciya inda ƴarta ce ai ba za ta yi shiru ba dole ta ɗau mataki, don kare ƴarta da lafiyarta.

"Ai tunda tare ku ke, bari ya shigo sai ki ji komai daga bakinsa".

Hajja Miƙewa tayi tana miƙawa Mami yaron, da hanzari ta nufi hanyar ficewa daga ɗakin, don sosai zuciyarta take tsalle daga yanayin da ta ga Mami ta fahimci akwai matsala. Haba shiyasa da ta shigo ta ga duk sun tsume mata, Nusaiba ko gaisheta ba ta yi ba, abinda bata taɓa yi mata ba in har ta je gidan Farouq har kasa take durkusawa ta gaisheta amma yau bata samu alfarmar haka ɗin ba kuma ta tabbatarwa kanta Farouq ne sila.

A can gefe ta hango Jamaal tsaye hannunsa riƙe da waya, yana dannawa amma yanayin fuskarsa kamar baƙin hadari, kallo ɗaya tayi masa ta ɗauke kanta, ta nufi harabar asibitin in da Farouq ya yi Parking.

Cikin Mota ta hango shi zaune ya jingina kansa da kujera idanunsa a lumshe, tana isa ta kwankwasa masa, buɗe idanu ya yi ganinta ya sanya shi kai hannu yana murɗa ƙey ɗin motar yana tayar da ita, wani banzan kallo ta masa don ta lura tunaninsa tafiya za su yi.

"Ka kashe motar nan tun kafin ranka ya ɓaci".

Kallonta ya yi da wani irin yanayi, yana kokarin magana ya fasa ganin zallar ɓacin rai a fuskarta, sannan bai mance kalar gargaɗin datayi masa haɗi da tsoratarwa ba sanadin da ya biyo ta kenan don da ƙi ya yi, har gida ta je ta same shi, da farko ma Nasreem ce tafito ta sanar da ita baya nan, ta ƙi yarda ta shiga har ɗakin ta hango shi kwance saman gado maganganun da ta faɗa masa ne ya sanyashi hanzarin miƙewa ya biyo ta ba shiri.

"Ka fito nace maka, ko ranka ya ɓaci".

Ta sake faɗi. Kashe motar ya yi, ya fito yana kulleta.

"Muje".

Dubanta ya yi kamar zai yi magana sai kuma ya fasa, ta shiga gaba yana biye da ita har suka isa kofar ɗakin da su Mami suke. Jamaal dake can gefe ya dubi Farouq wanda shi ya kalle shi a lokacin, wani mugun kallo ya yi masa yana ɗauke kansa hakan ya sanya Farouq shima wurga masa kallo kalar nashi har da tukuicin tsaki, wanda ya sauka a kunnuwan Jamaal hakan ya sanya shi ɗago kai da sauri yana duban Farouq wanda ya shige ɗakin a lokaci, wani takaici da haushin Farouq ya ji sun danne masa zuciya ji yake kamar ya shaƙi wuyansa ya yi masa shegen duka.

Suna Shiga ɗakin ita kuma Mami na jikin ƙofar toilet tana kwankwasawa Nusaiba ta buɗe amma ta ƙi sai nishinta da take jiyowa hakan ya kara tada mata da hankali tana tsoron kar wani abu ya sami ƴarta. Shigowar su Hajja ne ya sanyata barin ƙofar tana komawa ta zauna, kallo ɗaya tayi wa Farouq ta ɗauke kai ganin yadda yake ta faman cika yana batsewa yana harare harare.

"Farouq".

Hajja ta faɗi. Tana kallonshi cikin yanayi na tsare gida, kafin ta dubi Mami tana faɗin.

"Lokacin da na sanar da kai Nusaiba ta haihuwa, ce min kayi bata nan, baka san in da tayi ba, ya akayi ta kasance wajan iyayenta har nakuda ta kamata har ta kai da anyi mata aiki sannan ta haihuwa?".

"Eh kamar yadda na faɗa miki, ban san inda take ba, don ta bar gidana gabadaya".

Cikin rashin fahimta Hajja ke dubansa, kafin ta maida kallonta ga Mami da take jin kalaman Farouq yadda yake furtasu da tsantsar fitsara da rashin kunya kuma wai mahaifiyarsa,kenan bai kamata ace ta damu don ya yi mata ba, tunda har zai iya yiwa mahaifiyarsa magana haka gatsal kamar yana magana da wata wacce suka  haɗu a bariki.
Girgiza kai kawai Hajja take yi don sosai Farouq yake bata mamaki yadda ya yi maganar ya yi matuƙar ɗaure mata kai, miƙewa tayi tana cigaba da dubansa.

"Ban fahimci abinda kake nufi ba, ya kamata ka fito min a yadda zan fahimta Farouq".

"Na saketa saki ɗaiɗai har biyu...".

Ya faɗi cike da gadara da isa, har yana wani daga kafaɗunsa alamun ba wani ɗar ko shakkar faɗin haka, sai dai tun kafin ya dire kalaman nasa yaji saukar mari hagu da dama Hajja ta ɗauke shi da su. Sautin marin yana amsa amo a ɗakin gabaɗaya Mami da sauri ta juya tana duban Hajja wacce take ta faman numfarfashi kamar mai cutar asthma idanunta sun kaɗa sun yi jajir lokaci guda.

"Ka san abinda ka faɗi Farouq, ka san wacece kake yiwa magana haka gatsal, ni ce fa mahaifiyarka ce, amma kake min magana kamar kana yi da wacce ka haɗu a titi da ita ko wani tsaranka...Me ya shiga kan ka ne?. Da har kake duban idanuna kace min ka saki Nusaiba har saki biyu".

Kallon da yake mata kawai ya sanyata yin kasa da kai hawaye suna wanke mata fuska lokaci guda, kallonta yake yi da wani kalar yanayi kamar zai rama ya haɗe fuskarsa tamon idanunsa suna nuna yanayi kamar wuta zata fito daga cikin su.

"Me tayi maka Farouq, me tayi maka, ka faɗa min. Duk kyautatawa da jurewa da take a gidanka amma sakayyar da zakayi mata kenan...Anya kana da hankali, anya akwai zuciya a kirjinka?".

"Hajja ni ban ga laifin da nayi ba, da har za ki mare ni. Nace bana son ta na tsane ta akan mi zan zauna da ita tana neman rayuwata, ke kan ki kin sani kawai rayuwata ce bata zo karshe ba amma da tuni kasa ta rufe min idanu".

Runtse idanu tayi tana buɗe su lokaci guda kallon Farouq take gani take kamar ba ɗanta ba, gani take kamar wani daban ne yake yi mata magana irin haka, amma idanunta da zuciyarta  sun ƙi karyata haka sautin amon muryarsa take ji har tsakiyar kanta tana amsa kuwwa hakan ya tabbatar mata da cewa ɗanta ne Farouq.

"Ko don albarkacin cikin dake jikinta, ka tausaya mata...".

"Ni fa ban ma yarda cikin jikinta nawa bane, ina shakka akansa...".

Shaƙar da yaji anyi wa wuyansa an buga kansa da bango ya sanya shi datse kalamansa lokaci guda ya ji kansa ya ɗauki wani irin shiru idanuwansa na lumshewa, zai iya rantsewa ya hango shi a wata duniyar mai tartsatsin wuta ba wai duniyar da yake rayuwa ba.

"Idan kasa ke furuci kalar wannan wallahi zan baka mamaki, sai na zazzage maka hakoran da suke taimaka maka wajan gaya wa mutane magana ta rashin mutunci".

Buɗe idanusa ya yi, yana ganin dishi-dishi kafin su washe, fuskar Jamaal ne yake ganin tana masa gizo kafin ta fito masa tar! hucin da yake saki yana bugan masa fuska, wuyansa da yaji ya shaƙa ji yake yi kamar yana kokarin tsinke jijiyoyin da suke maƙale tsakanin wuyansa da gangar jikinsa.

"Jamaal".

Mami ta faɗi tana mai nufar inda ya shaƙe Farouq ya haɗa shi da bango, hannunsa ta shiga kokarin kwacewa daga wuyan Farouq amma yadda ka san dutse ko motsi ba ya yi, dubansa tayi fuskarta da firgici sosai.

"Sakar masa wuya".

Kau da kansa ya yi wani irin ɗaci yake ji sosai a harshensa kalaman da Farouq ya furta ga Nusaiba yake jin su wani iri a dukkanin jikinsa, ba ya ji zai iya kyale shi.

"Jamaal da kai nake fa".

Numfashi ya ja ya fesar gami da buɗe idanunsa sosai a fuskar Farouq.

"Don girman Allah ka maimaita, wallahi sai na shayar da kai mamaki, sai na nuna maka iskancin naka ko cikin cokali bai kai ba".

Ya faɗi yana sakar masa wuya gami da hanƙaɗa shi gefe guda, saura kaɗan ya faɗi ya dafa lokar dake gefensa yana mai da numfashi, kafin ya miƙe sosai yana mai riƙe wuyansa da yake kamar ba a jikinsa ba, wani kallo ya yi wa Jamaal kafin ya dubi Mami da duk ta gama shiga firgici. Juyawa ya yi ya buɗe ƙofar yana ficewa daga ɗakin gami da buga ƙofar.

Kallan kallo aka shiga yi tsakanin Mami da Hajja wacce gabaɗaya jikinta ya gama yin sanyi wata irin kunya ce ta Mami take ji tana lulluɓeta ta ko ina.

"Don Allah...".

Da sauri Mami ta tare ta, tana faman gyaɗa kai zuciyarta a cure take tayi mata wani irin nauyi a kirji kamar zata rinjayeta leɓenta na kasa ta ciza kafin ta ɗauke kanta tana duban Jamaal wanda yake ta faman huci jikinsa sai rawa yake.

"Allah ya shiryesa ya ganar dashi gaskiya, amma Hajiya Maryam, In har Farouq bai janye munanan kalaman akan Nusaiba ba gaskiya kotu ita ce zata raba mu, don ba zan taɓa yarda da MUGUN ƘAZAFI irin wannan ba".

Kokarin magana ta sake yi a lokacin suka ji an sake bango ƙofar da ƙarfi,Farouq ya shigo bai dubi kowa ba ya riƙo hannun Hajja wacce ta koma kamar butum-butum kafin ya dubi Mami.

"Ba zan dai ba, kuma ba zan fasa faɗi ba, ina shakka akan wannan yaron da ta haifa".

Ya fizgi hannun Hajja suka fice daga ɗakin, Jamaal ya dubi Mami zuciyarsa na suya amma ta girgiza masa kai, a daidai lokacin kuma kamar saukar aradu suka jiyo ihun Nusaiba daga cikin toilet.

Rige rige aka shiga yi tsakanin Mami da Jamaal gabaɗayansu suka isa ga ƙofar amma suka tadda ita gam! wani wawan duka Jamaal ya kai mata ta buɗe suka faɗa cikin bayin, yashe suka hangeta a kasa kanta ya bugu da famfon bayin Goshinta inda akayi mata bandeji sai fidda ji yake, da gudu Jamaal ya karasa yana mai sunkutota gabaɗaya ya yo waje da ita, kan gado ya ajjeta Mami na iso wa ta shiga jinjigata amma ba alamar motsi a jikinta, ganin hakan ya sanya Jamaal  kwasa a guje don kiran Likita.
Kuka sosai Mami take yi, don ta rigaya ta karaya da al'amarin Nusaiba zuciyarta sosai ta karaya kukan ma ko tayi kokarin tsaida shi bata iya wa hawayen ne kawai ke zuba kamar an buɗe famfo mara gudu.

Idanunta ta sake kaiwa saitin Nusaiba wacce take kwance tamkar gawa ba wani inda ke motsi a jikinta numfashin nata bugawarsa sai da taimakon Oxgyen. Yau kwana biyu kenan amma kwankwarar motsi ba ta yi ba, hakan ya kara rikita wa Mami Lissafi  ba shiri ta kira Dr.Kutigi ta sanar dashi abinda ke faruwa don da farko tun daga haihuwar Nusaiba ɗin bata gaya masa ba dalili don bata so ta tayar masa da hankali zatonta har ayi wa Nusaiba Cs su koma gida ba abinda zai faru amma yanzu kam ta sare ba za ta iya ba zuciyarta ba za ta iya ɗaukar yanayin da take ganin ƴarta a ciki ba.

Hawaye ta share tana mai kai hannunta tana shafar gefen fuskar Nusaiba ɗin wacce tayi fayau kamar ta yar shekara sha biyar.

"Ban san mi zan ce dake ba Nusaiba, amma na san an cuci rayuwarki, ba zan taɓa yafewa Zuri'ar Hajja ba, shiyasa tun farko zuciyata ta ƙi amanna da aure nan kawai ba yadda zan yi ne".

Ta karashe tana mai riƙo hannun Nusaiba tana riƙewa cikin nata. Kukan da jaririn ya kwantsama ne ya sanya Mami duban gefen gadon da yake miƙewa tayi ta isa tana mai zaro shi daga cikin gadon kallonta yake yi hannunsa cikin baki hakan ya tabbatar mata  da yunwa yake ji, runtse idani tayi wani irin tausayinsa na kamata sosai yaro kamar wannan amma ace a sati ɗaya bai samu ingantacciyar kulawa daga mahaifiya ba.

"Mami".

Muryar Yaa Jamaal ta katse mata dogon tunanin da ta afka, numfashi taja mai karfi tana saukewa kafin ta juya tana dubansa da koɗaɗɗun idanuwanta da suka gajiya da kuka. Tsaye yake jikin ƙofa hannayensa harɗe a kirjinsa, shi kansa gabaɗaya ya canza ya yi wani irin yanayi mai kama da wanda ya tashi daga cuta, fuskarsa ta kara zama fayau kasumbar da ya tara ta kara cika sosai. 

Girgiza kai ya shiga yi yana karasowa cikin ɗakin sosai, kafin ya miƙawa Mami hannu idanuwansa a fuskar jaririn, hakan da ta gani ya sanyata miƙa masa shi tana mai faɗin.

"Yunwa yake ji Jamaal, bai ci komai ba yanzu ya tashi daga barci".

Ta karashe da wani irin rauni a muryarta kwalla suna cika mata idanu da sauri ta ɗauke kanta, bata so Jamaal ya ga hawayenta duk da ba shine na farko ba ya san tana kuka amma bata so ya cigaba da ganin kukanta sosai take hango rauni a idanunsa sosai take hango damuwa a tattare dashi.

"Mami mana".

Ya faɗi yana mai isowa gareta amma ta ƙi kallonsa idanuwanta a kasa zuciyarta bugawa take yi sosai da wani irin yanayi.

"Me yasa kiƙa faɗawa Dady...Mami da ba ki faɗa masa ba, ki bar shi har ya dawo...hankalinsa zai ta shi sosai ba tare da ya gama abinda ya je yi ba...".

Wani irin jiri ne ta ji yana kokarin kayar da ita da sauri ta isa bakin gadon Nusaiba tana zama hannayenta duk biyu dafe da kanta.

"Jamaal ba yadda zan yi ne, dole na faɗa masa. Ina tsoron yanayin da Nusaiba take ciki bana so ace mun rasata, komai na san na duniyar nan Muƙaddari ne, amma zan so ace komai ya faru a gabansa".

Ta karashe daƙyar tana mai cizon laɓɓanta idanuwanta a runtse.

"Dagaske za ta samu lafiya Doctor yace tana farkawa komai zai daidaita. Ban san za ki kira shi ba da na hanaki Mami.Yanzu yace min yana hanya, yana ta faɗa me yasa ba a faɗa masa ba me yasa ban kira shi na sanar masa ba tun da ke ƙin ki kiran shi...inda ƴar sa ta mutu ba zai yafe mana ba haka fa ya ce Mami".

Dubansa Mami tayi yanayin da yake yi da fuska ya tabbatar mata da cewa maganganun da Dr.Kutigi ya faɗa masa ba su yi masa dadi ba, ita kanta ta san bata kyauta ba, inda Nusaiba ta mutu sai dai ya ji, sai dai ita ba ta yi haka bane da wata manufa a,a tayi don kar ta tada masa da hankali bata yi tsammanin abinda zai lalace har haka ba.

"Bana son tada masa da hankali Jamaal, shiyasa ban faɗa masa ba.Ban yi tsammanin lamarin zai lalace haka ba...na san dama hakan za ta kasance zan bashi hakuri in ya dawo".

Ta faɗi tana mai duban Nusaiba kafin ta miƙe tana nufar inda suke ajje kayansu flast ta ɗauko ta tsiyaya ruwan zafi a ɗan kofi sannan ta ɗauko madarar jaririn da likita ya shawarce su su sayo suke haɗawa suna baiwa yaron. Haɗawa tayi daidai yadda zai iya sha ta dubi Jamaal da ya rungume shi a kirjinsa sosai kamar zai mai dashi ciki, gyaɗa kai kawai take yi wani abu take ji yana tsirga mata cikin zuciya.

"Barci ya tashi...kawo shi na bashi".

Ta faɗi idanunta a fuskar Jamaal, da yake ta faman dakunata tun da ta faɗi ya kawo shi.

"A,a Mami zan iya, kawo na bashi".

"Jamaal mana. Yaushe ka koyi rainon yara ne wai,ni ban sani ba".

Dakuna fuska ya sake yi, yana sake rungume yaron a kirji.

"Don Allah...".

Ganin dai da gaske yake ta miƙa masa karamin kofin, hannu ya sanya ya karba yana nufar kujera ya zauna ya kwantar da yaron a cinyarsa, a hankali ya shiga ɗiba yana bashi yana masa wasa yaron shi kuma yana sha yana faman bangale masa baki.

Mami idanu ta zuba masa, wani irin yanayi take ji a ranta game da Jamaal. Kafin ta shiga girgiza kai tana kokarin zare tunanin da yake zuwa mata zuciya.

"Mami yau sati ɗaya, ya kamata ace izuwa wannan lokaci yaron nan an masa huɗuba".

"Hmmm..Jamaal kenan Ubansa ya kamata ya yi masa amma kana kallon halin da ya nuna mana, ni kuma bani da kwanciyar hankali, samun lafiyar ɗiyata nake bukata".

Bai ce da ita komai ba, har ya karasa bashi madara ya goge masa baƙi sannan ya daura shi a kafaɗa ya mike tsaye yana shafa masa baya a hankali.

"Zan masa huɗuba".

Ya faɗi yana mai sauke shi, idanuwansa yake lumshewa alamun barci yake ji, zama ya yi sosai yana mai kallon yaron kafin ya kai bakinsa saitin kunnansa na dama ya yi masa kiran Sallah sannan ya yi a na hagu, yana mai cigaba da yi masa addu'o'i.

"Mashkur".

Ya faɗi yana mai jan hancin yaron.Da sauri Mami ta dago kanta tana dubansa.
"Mashkur".

Ta faɗi da yanayi na tambaya, dago kai ya yi ya dube ta da murmushi a fuskarsa.

"Eh Mami. Mashkur...don Allah kar ki ce a canza".

Gyaɗa kai kawai tayi, tana mamakin rigimar Jamaal ta yadda ba tare da sanin uban ɗa ba ya saka masa suna zaɓin sa.

"Allah ya raya shi Ya albarkaci rayuwarsa".

Ta faɗi don bata son jan zancen ta san Jamaal ba canzawa zai yi daga abinda ya aikata ba, ko tayi magana ɓata bakinta za ta yi musamman da ta kawo masa zancen Farouq a yadda yake cike dashi rigima zai balle mata dashi.
***
Tunda suka baro asibitin yake jin kansa wani iri, ya yi masa nauyi sosai kamar an ɗaura masa ƙaton dutse, ciwo yake ji yanayi masa na ban mamaki ya rasa dalili, ya sha magani amma hakan ya ƙi warkar dashi barci ma bai iyayi da daddare, ko ya rufe idanunsa barcin bai yuwuwa fuskar Nusaiba yake ji da sautin ihun ta da yaji a lokacin da yake barin ɗakin da suke yake ji yana amsa masa kuwwa cikin kai.

Haka zai ta shi ya zauna, yana ajiyar numfashi don wani sa'ilin numfashinsa ma ji yake yi yana sarsarƙewa kamar zai ɗauke gabaɗaya.

"Me ka aikata haka Farouq, tambayar ka nake me ka aikata haka?".

Muryar Mami yake ji tana sake dawo masa cikin kai a lokacin da suka baro asibitin yana hawa titi.Muryar da kuka a cikinta hakan ya sanya shi runtse idanu yana dubanta kafin ya ɗauke kansa da yake ji ya yi masa wani irin nauyi.

"Hajja...ban san mi zan ce miki ba, amma da gaske bana son ganin fuskarta...".

"Farouq".

Ta kira shi da wata irin murya mai tattare da tashin hankali sosai, dubansa take daga in da take zaune a gidan baya, ta gilashin gaban motar take hangon sa fuskarsa take kallo ba alamun damuwa ko kaɗan sai ma kamar fushi da ta hango hakan ya kara sanya zuciyarta bugawa da karfi wani abu take ji yana taso mata daga cikin zuciyar yana zarcewa cikin kwanyarta yana watsewa gami da haifar mata da wani irin tunani.

"Yaa Hayyu Yaa Kayyum".

Abinda ta shiga ambata kenan cikin rawar jiki tana mai kara buɗe idanunta ga Farouq da ya cigaba da tukinsa lokaci-lokaci yana lumshe idanu ya buɗe.

"Farouq me ya shiga kan ka, don Allah ka faɗa min. In baka da lafiya ne ka sanar dani".

Wani wawan burki ya ja, yana mai tsayawa wanda hakan ya sanya Hajja runtse idanu don duk a zatonta accident ne sukayi amma jin numfashi Farouq na fita da karfi karfi har tana jin sautin sa hakan ya sanyata buɗe idanu tana dubansa da wani irin yanayi kafin ta dauke ajiyar zuciya mai kwari.

"Mami me yasa ki ke faɗin haka, bana so ki daina. Lafiyata kalau gaskiya nake faɗa miki".

Baki ta saki galala tana dubansa, zuciyarta na kara tabbatar mata zarginta cewa ba kalau yake ba.Gyaɗa kai ta shiga yi kawai zuciyarta na sake tsorata da al'amarinsa. Da wannan yanayin har suka isa gida ba tare da ta ce masa komai ba ta buɗe murfin motar ta fice.

Tana shiga falo ta tadda Alhaji Ma'arouf don shi kansa bai san abinda ke faruwa ba, kallon shi tayi a lokaci guda wasu hawaye suka zubo mata, hakan ya sanya shi dubanta cikin yanayi na mamaki.

"Kuka kuma me ke faruwa ne?".

Kamar jira take ya tanka mata, ta sake fashewa da kuka mai tushe tana mai zubewa a tsakiyar falon.

"Ban san ta ina zan fara maka ba alaji, amma Farouq ya rigaya ya zubda mana da mutunci. Akwai abubuwa da suka faru da yawa game da gidansa ba ka sani ba ina boye ma don bana so ka sani ɗin, a tunani na zan iya saisaita komai ashe ba haka al'amarin yake ba. Yaron nan Farouq tunda akayi auren nan nasa yake cutar da ƴar mutane har ta samu juna biyu amma yaron nan bai raga mata ba, har ta kai ga yana mata ƙamshin mutuwa...".

Ta nisa tana mai jan hanci gami da face majina. Alhaji Ma'arouf kuwa kasake ya yi yana dubanta don jin maganganunta yake kamar tatsuniya, sai dai ya san Hajja ba za ta shirya masa labarin ƙanzon kurege ba, hakan ya sanya zuciyarsa harbawa jin abinda take karanto masa game da Farouq.

"Dukanta yake yi har ta kai ga abinci ma bai bata, har cikin ya girma tsabar hankalin sa ba ya jikinsa a ranar da za ta haihu a ranar ya sake ta, sai dai iyayenta suka zo suka kwashe ta, haka suka nufi asibiti da ita haihuwa kasa yi tayi da kanta don bala'i da damuwa da ya cusa mata sai aiki akayi mata aka ciro ɗan".

Ta karashe tana mai dafe kanta da take ji yana barazanar rabewa gida biyu don ba karamin tashin hankali take ciki ba, ba abinda yake kara ɗaure mata kai sai ta yadda Farouq ya koma son Nasreem lokaci ɗaya, in ta tuna lokacin da akayi aurensa kiyayya da barazana ba wanda bai yiwa Nasreem ba amma yanzu ace ya kama sonta Matar da ya nuna yana so kamar ransa ita ce yanzu ya koma tsana.

wannan al'amari ya yi matukar ɗaure mata kai shiyasa take ji a ranta tabbas akwai yadda akayi akwai abinda ke damun Farouq ba haka kalau yake ba.

"Dagaske Alhaji Farouq ba kalau yake ba, akwai abinda ya shigar masa cikin kai".

Ta sake faɗi tana mai miƙewa ta zauna kan kujera tana faman sharar kwalla. A daidai lokacin Farouq ya shigo Falon kalaman Mami na karshe na sauka cikin kunnuwansa.

"Hajja na faɗa miki ni ba abinda yake damuna, amma kin kasa fahimta, ki daina dangantani da wata rashin lafiya...na faɗa miki bana son ta bana buƙatar ganinta cikin gidana ko kaɗan ya kamata ki fahimce ni".

Tunda ya shigo Alhaji Ma'arouf yake dubansa yana karantar yanayinsa wani irin yake ji a zuciyarsa game da Farouq ɗin daga yanayin da yake furucinsa ya tabbatar masa ba lafiya ba, runtse idanu ya yi yana buɗewa wani tashin hankali na ziyartarsa, bayanin Hajja jin su yake yi kamar al'mara zuciyarsa har yanzu rawa take ta kasa yarda wai Farouq ɗinsa ne ya koma haka, ya kasa yarda wai Farouq ɗinsa ne ya koma MUGUN NAMIJI ga iyalinsa.
